description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
 The Talent Business Advisor \- Manager is the accessible, on\-the\-ground HR partner for employees and leaders within assigned India Business Units (BU). This is an integral role in managing the execution of people\-related initiatives and programs that enhance the employee experience for India talent. Reporting to the U.S. Talent Business Advisor team and working with the India Talent Director and local leadership, this role supports the operational and logistical needs of key talent processes and employee matters helping ensure a consistent, efficient, and people\-centered approach to talent delivery.
   

  

 This role collaborates with a range of stakeholders across the Talent Solutions team and business units to execute core HR functions such as onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, and workforce logistics. This position offers a unique opportunity to broaden and deepen experience in talent operations while learning how HR strategy is implemented in a professional services environment.
   

  

**Required Responsibilities**
* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and leadership on talent, HR policy and procedures.
* Build trusted relationships with BU leaders and provide practical counsel on business unit needs, employee matters and emerging talent risks. Work closely with India Talent Director and peers.
* Partner globally with U.S. Talent Business Leader and U.S. Advisors to manage the implementation of core talent processes across the employee lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, performance management, absences, rewards processes, and employee engagement initiatives).
* Provide accurate local and Firm context, recommendations and regular status updates and visibility to the US Talent Business Leader; seek direction or approval for BU\-specific or sensitive matters.
* Translate agreed guidance into clear stakeholder actions, establish owners and timelines, and follow each matter through resolution and formal closure.
* Create insightful reporting and analytics, with recommendations that inform leadership talent decisions.
* Identify recurring employee themes or policy misunderstandings and support targeted communications and consistent practices across India BUs.


**Capabilities**
* Demonstrated HR advisory, HR business partnering or generalist experience supporting both employees and business leaders in India.
* Experience handling employee concerns and workplace matters, including fact gathering, risk assessment, documentation, escalation and follow\-through.
* Practical knowledge of India\-specific HR policies, employment practices, governance and local requirements, with sound judgment on when specialist or legal guidance is needed.
* Experience operating across the employee lifecycle and coordinating with specialist teams such as Employee Relations, HR operations, etc.
* Strong stakeholder management in a matrixed environment, including the ability to work effectively with local leaders and remotely based business or talent leaders.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain policy, provide concise and proactive updates, surface risk and communicate sensitive decisions appropriately.
* High levels of discretion, empathy, organization and accountability, with a consistent record of driving actions to closure.
* Strong Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, HR technology platforms such as Workday, reporting tools, and approved AI\-enabled resources.


**Professional Expectations**
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, professionalism, and independent execution and management of assigned responsibilities.
* Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing work, identifying risk, recognizing matters requiring escalation, and protecting confidential information.
* Produce accurate, organized, and high\-quality work products with strong attention to detail and data integrity.
* Anticipate needs, proactively address operational challenges, and approach change with a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Build strong working relationships through responsive communication, follow\-through, and service excellence.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred.
* 7\-10 years of human resources, talent management, employee experience, people operations, business operations, or related professional experience preferred.
* Experience in a multinational, shared\-services or globally matrixed organization.
* Experience partnering with US\-based or other international HR and business stakeholders across time zones.
* Exposure to talent reviews, succession, career development, recognition, engagement and retention programs.
* Experience supporting organizational movement, promotions, role changes, mobility and employee exits.
* Experience identifying workforce themes and turning recurring issues into targeted manager or employee communications.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: Key Accounts Coordinator
description:
**About Orica** 




  





 At Orica, it’s the power of our people that leads change and shapes our futures. Every day, all around the world, our people help mobilise vital resources essential to progress. Established in 1874, we have grown to become the world leader in mining and civil blasting with a diverse of team of more than 13,000 across the world.
 



  





 It’s an exciting time to join us – we are shaping the future of mining through digital and automated technologies, embracing new ways of thinking, pioneering innovation and reimagining the way we work.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 At Orica, we work closely with some of the world's leading mining operations to deliver safe, reliable, and innovative blasting solutions.
 



  





 As an Account Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting customer outcomes through commercial coordination, business analysis, forecasting, reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration. Working alongside operational, technical, commercial, supply chain, and finance teams, you will help ensure the efficient delivery of products and services while contributing to customer satisfaction and business performance.
 



  





 This role offers a unique opportunity to combine engineering knowledge with commercial and business exposure. You will gain insight into how mining operations, customer relationships, forecasting, business planning, and commercial performance come together to support successful customer outcomes. In addition, you will provide technical and commercial support to the Account Business Manager (ABM), gaining valuable exposure to customer engagement, account management, business planning, and operational coordination. Working with experienced professionals and leading mining customers, you will develop a broad understanding of the mining value chain while building capabilities that can open future career pathways across commercial, operational, technical, and business leadership roles.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 




  




* Coordinate customer\-facing commercial and operational activities to support the safe, efficient, and reliable delivery of products and services.
* Analyse customer consumption, operational, and commercial data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate forecasting and planning activities to support customer requirements and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain KPI reports, commercial analysis, customer performance reporting, and business dashboards.
* Maintain customer, contract, pricing, and master data within business systems, ensuring accuracy and data integrity.
* Monitor contract performance, customer commitments, and key commercial metrics.
* Provide technical and commercial coordination support to the Account Business Manager, including the preparation of reports, presentations, customer information, and business performance insights.
* Support customer onboarding activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate CSR activities and assist with stakeholder engagement initiatives within the region.
* Track customer feedback, service\-related issues, and improvement opportunities to help drive positive customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with Commercial, Technical Services, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to support customer and business needs.
* Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.



  





**What you will bring** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Mining Engineering, Mineral Engineering, or other engineering qualifications will be highly regarded.
* Engineering graduates and early\-career professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.
* Experience in mining, mining services, technical services, commercial support, account management, planning, business analysis, or customer\-facing roles is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational and commercial data.
* Understanding of mining operations, drill and blast activities, production environments, or resource industries will be highly regarded.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with data, reporting, and performance metrics.
* Experience with SAP, ERP systems, Power BI, or similar business systems is advantageous.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive mindset and willingness to build a career at the intersection of operations, customer engagement, and commercial performance.



  





**What we offer** 




  





 As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.
 



  





 You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.
 



  





**We respect and value all** 




  





 Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone’s contributions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, nationality, age, military or veteran, marital or disability status.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Company Description** 
 MindLytics is a next\-generation data and analytics company that helps organizations turn raw data into actionable intelligence. The team specializes in building scalable data infrastructure, advanced analytics solutions, and modern visualization platforms to support faster, smarter decision\-making. MindLytics partners with both startups and growing enterprises to enable data\-driven cultures through reliable data pipelines, cloud\-based architectures, and business intelligence solutions. The company’s mission is to convert raw data into real business value by delivering practical, impact\-focused data solutions to its clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time remote Data Scientist role focuses on designing and implementing data\-driven solutions that address complex business problems. The Data Scientist will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to collect, analyze, and model data, and to translate findings into clear, actionable insights. Daily responsibilities include building and validating statistical and machine learning models, performing exploratory data analysis, and developing dashboards or visualizations that communicate key metrics and trends. The role also involves maintaining clean, reliable datasets, contributing to scalable data pipelines, and documenting methodologies to support reproducibility and ongoing improvement.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Science and Statistics for modeling, experimentation, and inference.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Analytics and Data Analysis for interpreting complex datasets and generating insights.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Visualization for building clear dashboards and visual reports.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and experience with SQL or other query languages.
* Familiarity with machine learning libraries, cloud\-based data platforms, and version control tools.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with business intelligence tools and building end\-to\-end analytics solutions is beneficial.

description:

 Full\-time, On\-site
   

  

**About Zoid\-**
 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup developing advanced defence and aerospace technologies for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers. Our work spans AI, electronics, robotics, autonomous systems and UAV platforms.
   

  

 Our current projects include AI\-based FOD detection for naval air stations, GNSS\-denied navigation, aerial intelligent mapping, reusable off\-board missile decoys, vision\-based kinetic strike systems and drone swarming solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview\-**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Systems Engineer** 
 to support the end\-to\-end design, integration, testing, flight operations and deployment of UAV systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong practical knowledge of drone hardware, avionics, flight controllers, power systems, communication links, payload integration and field testing. The candidate must be comfortable manually flying small to medium\-category UAVs and travelling to test locations across India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**UAV Systems \& Integration**
* Lead, design and assemble end\-to\-end integration of UAV subsystems: propulsion, avionics, control, payload and power.
* Hands\-on with various frame designs — Quad/Hex/Octa copters, fixed\-wing, VTOL, etc.
* Select suitable drives, electronic components, sensors and hardware.
* Knowledge of motors, ESCs, propellers — their specs and configuration.
* Configure, integrate, calibrate and auto\-tune flight controllers (Pixhawk, Cube Orange\+, PX4, etc.).
* Analyse flight logs using Mission Planner, QGroundControl or MAVLink tools for pre\- and post\-flight debugging.
* Knowledge of standard flight modes (stabilize, althold, poshold, loiter, land, rtl, guided, auto), fail\-safes (RC, GCS, battery, geofence, EKF) and mission planning.
* Familiar with standard Pixhawk Cube parameters and setting them via Mission Planner.


**Communication \& Networking**
* Ability to configure IP networks — IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, routing — and get companion computers, flight controllers, payload processors, routers and ground stations talking on the same network.
* Knowledge of serial communication protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232, including baud rates and debugging.
* Understanding of telemetry radios, RC links, video links, mesh networks, Ethernet, LTE/5G modems, VPN/routing and IP\-based payload communication.
* Understanding of MAVLink routing, UDP/TCP endpoints, packet loss, latency and link redundancy.


**Basic RF knowledge** 
 — understanding of what a signal is and the fundamentals behind it.
   

  

**Power System Design**
* Understanding of Li\-ion/LiPo packs, C\-rating, discharge curves, BMS, cell balancing and safe charging/discharging.
* Ability to calculate power Budget, current draw, endurance, payload power and voltage rail requirements.
* Knowledge of PDBs, DC\-DC converters, BECs, fuses, connectors, wire gauge selection and grounding.
* Troubleshoot brownouts, voltage drops, ESC desync, power noise and overheating.


**Sensor \& Payload Integration**
 Integrate EO/IR cameras, gimbals, LiDAR, rangefinders, GNSS/RTK modules, IMUs, magnetometers, payload controllers and RF payloads.
   

  

* Read sensor datasheets and understand interfaces, power needs, mounting constraints and calibration.
* Test payload data flow from sensor → onboard computer → ground station.
* Ability to read datasheets, schematics, pinouts and reference manuals to bring up and test embedded boards.


**Software \& Development**
* Python skills are mandatory for development, log analysis / visualization, automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Ubuntu / Linux is required, including basic commands (SSH, SCP, mkdir, cd, rm, etc.) and day\-to\-day use of a Linux environment.
* Basic firmware development, flashing, debugging and peripheral interfacing on microcontrollers such as STM32, ESP32, Arduino or similar.


**Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or degree in Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or a related field. Equivalent experience also considered.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 3 years in a Avionics Systems Engineer preferably in a startup, R\&D or defence\-tech setup.
* Prior experience in defence/aerospace product testing and deployment.
* Experience building and operating drones from scratch and running day\-to\-day autonomous/semi\-autonomous flights.


**Hands\-on Skills**
* Integrating flight controllers with ESCs, GPS, power modules, telemetry, RF systems and onboard computers.
* Familiarity with aviation regulations and military standards for UAV development is a plus.


**Core Skills\-**
* Proficiency in MS Office, Canva, AI Tool like Claude.
* Strong problem\-solving — able to think critically and creatively about complex engineering challenges.
* Good communication skills for working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in English is mandatory.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to travel to test sites across India.
* Comfortable working outdoors for extended durations.


**Preferred Skills**
 Beyond the requirements above, any of the following is a big plus:
   

  

* Advanced software experience with C\+\+, ROS and Gazebo.
* Familiarity with embedded processors beyond standard computers — microcontrollers, SBCs, SoCs and FPGA\-based development boards.
* Basic familiarity with FPGA / SoC\-FPGA workflows: HDL, synthesis, bitstream generation, programming and hardware validation using tools like Vivado/Vitis or similar.
* Awareness of different RF architectures, with the judgement to do design and analysis of the subsystems in an RF chain.
* Understanding of antenna theory, types of signals, jamming signals and SDRs

title: User Experience Analyst
description:
**Role:** 
 UI/UX Analyst (D2C Product)
 



**Reports To:** 
 Lead D2C
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Work from Office)
 



  





**Nature of Business \& What You'll Own** 




 As UI/UX Analyst, you'll
 **diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data.** 




 You're not a pure designer. You're not a pure analyst. You're the
 **bridge** 
 – using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify
 *why* 
 customers drop off, and designing solutions to test.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Session recording analysis \- watch session recordings 2–3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns
2. UX friction diagnosis – combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements
3. A/B test variant design – sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy
4. Design system maintenance — collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website
5. Insight reporting – weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings
6. Tool evaluation – research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow



 You'll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user\-centric improvements across the platform.
 



  





**Technical Capabilities Required:** 




**Design Tools \& Prototyping:** 



* **Figma proficiency** 
 (non\-negotiable) – component\-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes
* Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering
* Understanding of mobile\-first design



**Analytics \& Data Tools( good to have):** 



* **GA4** 
 –funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool)
* **Session recording tools** 
 – session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification
* Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements
* Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters)



**Platform \& E\-Commerce Context:** 



* Familiarity of
 **e\-commerce platforms** 
 – enough to know what's possible and what's a technical constraint
* Familiarity with
 **conversion funnel** 
 – browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout → payment → confirmation



**Tools You Can Learn \& Suggest:** 



* You're encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow –
 **UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo** 
 , etc.
* You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools



  





**Functional Capabilities Required:** 




**Conversion Psychology:** 



* Understand micro\-interactions that drive decision\-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency)
* Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals)
* Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking – what job is the customer hiring this product for?



**UX Research \& Data Literacy:** 



* Can read a session recording and identify 3–5 UX issues
* Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas)
* Comfortable asking "why" – always validate assumptions with data before designing



**A/B Testing \& Iteration:** 



* Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork
* Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels)
* Iterate based on results – learn from losses, compound wins



**Communication \& Collaboration:** 



* Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early
* Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way
* Comfortable with ambiguity — you'll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* **2–3 years** 
 of UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e\-commerce, or D2C preferred)
* **Figma expertise** 
 \- can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency
* **Conversion psychology** 
 – understand how small UX changes impact user behavior
* **Data literacy** 
 – comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools
* **Mobile\-first thinking** 
 – design for phones first, then desktop
* **India D2C context** 
 – nice\-to\-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable
* **Written communication** 
 — can document findings clearly and present to non\-designers



  





**To apply , please complete the following 2 questions:** 




  





**Task 1 Description:** 




 Audit The Whole Truth Foods' website (thewholetruthfoods.com), specifically the
 **product browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout flow** 
 . Identify 4\-5 friction points or UX issues that could impact conversion rate. For 2 of these issues, design a proposed improvement in Figma or any free design tool (Penpot, Excalidraw, Figma free tier). Include a written analysis explaining:
 


* What friction you identified (and why it matters)
* How you'd measure the impact of your proposed change
* Hypothesis for what conversion lift you'd expect



  





**Task 2 Description:** 




 Your GA4 shows that 42% of users land on the homepage, but only 18% click into a category page. Of those who do, only 8% complete a purchase. Heatmap data shows the category navigation menu has low click\-through \- users instead using the search bar. Session recordings reveal users are confused about the difference between similar products (e.g., Whey Protein vs. Plant Protein, or different protein bar flavors). The exit rate on category pages is 35%."
 



**Candidate's Task:** 



1. **Diagnose the issue** 
 – Write 150–200 words on why category navigation is underperforming and how it impacts the funnel (consider: information overload, product differentiation, filtering options, trust signals)
2. **Propose 3 design/UX changes** 
 — Could include: improved category page layout, better filtering, comparison tools, simplified navigation, product badge/labeling, etc.
3. **Design 1 variant** 
 – Redesigned category page or navigation menu in Figma/free tool
4. **Testing \& insights plan** 
 – How would you test? What secondary metrics matter (e.g., time on category page, filter usage, comparison tool clicks)?

description:
**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients throughout the building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through construction, commissioning, and ongoing asset management. The consultancy provides expert guidance on lifts, escalators, moving walkways, façade maintenance, and specialist access systems, integrating safety, performance, and maintainability from early design stages. D\&B works across sectors including high\-rise, residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, airports, transport infrastructure, and mixed\-use developments. As a manufacturer\-neutral firm, D\&B’s recommendations are driven by safety, operational efficiency, lifecycle needs, and client interests, helping create safe, efficient, future\-ready buildings.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Graduate Engineering Trainee will support senior engineers and consultants in delivering vertical transportation and façade access projects, with a focus on technical analysis, design coordination, and documentation. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting with data collection, technical calculations, report preparation, and reviewing drawings and specifications for lifts, escalators, and façade access systems. The role involves collaborating with project teams, attending internal and external meetings, and contributing to project planning, tracking, and quality assurance activities. The Trainee will also help with research on standards, codes, and emerging technologies relevant to vertical transportation and façade access, and support site visits and inspections under supervision. This is a full\-time hybrid role, based in Bengaluru, with a combination of office\-based work and some work\-from\-home flexibility.

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written reporting and effective interpersonal communication in multidisciplinary teams.

* Candidates should possess foundational Project Management skills to assist with task planning, schedule tracking, and coordination of project deliverables.

 We are growing, shipping every week, and looking for engineers who can own a problem end to end \- interface, API, data, security, and deployment \- rather than a single layer of the stack.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We are hiring a Frontend\-focused SDE to own the quality of the product experience: structure, visual clarity, interaction, and performance. You will spend most of your time on the interface, but you will not throw work over the wall. You will integrate with real APIs, respect authentication and role\-based visibility, and help take a working demo to a polished, deployable product.
 




  






 You will work with full\-stack peers on the API and data model. You should be comfortable reading backend contracts, flagging when the UI needs a different API shape, and making design decisions when there is no finished Figma file.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




**Core Frontend Development** 



* Build production\-grade applications using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS (Tailwind or equivalent). Next.js (App Router) is strongly preferred.
* Create reusable components and a consistent design language: type, spacing, density, and interaction states.
* Implement application shells, navigation, filters, tables, forms, and empty / error / loading states that hold up in daily use.
* Optimize performance: code\-splitting, list virtualization where needed, caching, and careful rendering.
* Ship responsive, accessible interfaces across common devices and browsers.



  





**Product UI \- Dashboards and Workflows** 



* Build complex operational UIs: dashboards, data\-heavy tables, charts, and interactive workflows.
* Implement map or location\-aware views when the product needs them, with clear legend, hover, and drill\-through behaviour.
* Build AI\-assisted surfaces when required (chat or assistant panels, streaming text, citations, structured actions) without sacrificing clarity.
* Ensure every view respects role\-based visibility: what a user can see and click must match their permissions.



  





**Design Responsibility** 



* Translate requirements and rough sketches into a coherent interface. Pixel\-perfect when a design exists; disciplined taste when it does not.
* Own visual consistency across the product. You are accountable for the look and feel, not only for “making it work”.
* Use industry\-standard UI tools (Figma or equivalent) to communicate proposals when that saves engineering time.
* Raise issues early when a workflow is confusing, overcrowded, or unsafe (for example, a destructive action without confirmation).



  





**APIs, Auth, and Working With the Rest of the Stack** 



* Integrate with REST APIs from Node or Python services. Handle pagination, errors, and stale data correctly.
* Work with session or JWT authentication and render the product differently by role without leaking privileged UI.
* Use TanStack Query (or equivalent) for server state and a small, explicit store for client state.
* Partner with backend engineers on contract changes. You should be able to read an OpenAPI spec or a FastAPI router and reason about it.
* Contribute to the last mile of deployment: environment\-specific configuration, build pipelines, and verifying the UI on staging and on\-premises installs.



  





**Engineering Quality** 



* Write maintainable TypeScript. Prefer explicit types and small components over large files.
* Participate in code review and keep the frontend testable (component tests and critical\-path E2E).
* Instrument the UI enough to debug production issues (meaningful errors, not silent empty screens).
* Travel occasionally to client or on\-premises locations in Hyderabad for UAT, go\-live support, or on\-site reviews.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–2\+ years of production frontend experience (more is welcome).
* Strong React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
* Confidence with CSS layout and a utility or design\-token approach (Tailwind or equivalent).
* Experience integrating authenticated APIs and handling real\-world data, not only mock JSON.
* A portfolio that shows visual judgement: spacing, hierarchy, and polish you personally shipped.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Hyderabad and to travel to client or on\-premises sites as required.



  





**Location, Work Mode, and Travel** 





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. You will work in person with the engineering team.
 





 Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support. Travel is typically short\-duration and planned; willingness to travel within Hyderabad (and occasionally nearby) is a condition of the role.
 




  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary with a clear growth path.
* High\-ownership work: you will influence architecture, security, and how the product is shipped.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted products, enterprise\-grade access control, and real production deployments.
* Fast execution cycles and a culture that values demonstrated capability over credentials alone.
* Learning budget for courses and certifications.
* Collaborative in\-office engineering culture in Hyderabad.

description:

Meet the Team
  
  

You will be joining a high\-impact, globally connected talent acquisition team operating at the heart of our APJC growth strategy. We operate as a strategic engine for the region, partnering closely with business leaders to identify and attract the innovators who will define the future of technology. We don’t just fill roles; we build the teams that drive Cisco’s mission forward.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

This role strategizes Talent Acquisition by developing and implementing creative sourcing strategies to attract high\-quality candidates for various roles within the enterprise, often focusing on senior, specialized, or hard\-to\-fill positions.
  
  

It involves conducting thorough market mapping and analysis to understand where potential candidates are employed, industry trends, salary benchmarks, and the competitive landscape, which inform sourcing strategies.
  
  

Building and maintaining a pool of qualified talent through market research and ongoing relationship management ensures a robust talent pipeline.
  
  

The role acts as a brand advocate, representing the company in a positive light by communicating the company culture, values, and job opportunities to attract top talent. It requires close collaboration with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition teams to understand specific job requirements and support business objectives. Continuously improving the sourcing process by using new technologies, tools, and innovative sourcing techniques enhances efficiency and effectiveness.
  
  

The role ensures sourcing strategies are inclusive and designed to attract a diverse range of candidates to support the company's diversity and inclusion goals.
  
  

Additionally, data analytics is used to track sourcing metrics and outcomes, providing insights into the effectiveness of strategies and enabling data\-driven decision\-making to optimize the talent acquisition process.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, 9\+ years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition or Sourcing.
* Consistent track record as a senior individual contributor with deep expertise in sourcing for complex, specialized, or leadership\-level roles and proactively build and handle talent pools in key areas.
* Solves complex problems that involve creative sourcing for specialized roles or niche markets.
* Handles a higher level of complexity in work, often developing unique solutions to sourcing challenges.
* Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to perform root cause analysis and translate complex data sets into actionable recruitment strategies.
* Can lead projects and initiatives that transform sourcing capabilities within the team.
* Collaborates across different areas of HR and the business to align sourcing with strategic objectives.
* Makes significant decisions that can shape sourcing approaches and affect the quality of hires.
* Strong grasp of advanced sourcing techniques and talent market trends.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience leading large\-scale, cross\-functional recruitment projects or regional initiatives.
* Ability to operate with high autonomy in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes environment.
* Adept at using AI to create new ways of Sourcing and working with data (creating agents, dashboards etc.)
* Integrates business knowledge into sourcing strategies for optimal results.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* Experience with API performance testing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking an IAM Engineer to own identity infrastructure and access lifecycle operations across the enterprise. This role is focused on directory services, authentication, and identity governance at the platform level — Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, and automated provisioning. EHR application security (Epic templates, security classes, user profiles) is handled by a separate clinical applications team; this role supports that team upstream by ensuring accurate, timely identity data and account lifecycle events but does not perform EHR provisioning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Administer on\-prem Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID: user and group lifecycle, OU structure, GPOs, hybrid sync (Entra Connect), and conditional access policies.
* Execute and automate joiner/mover/leaver processes driven by the HR system of record, ensuring same\-day deprovisioning of departed workforce members across AD, M365, VPN, and downstream systems.
* Configure and maintain SSO integrations (SAML 2\.0, OIDC) for enterprise and third\-party applications; onboard new applications to the identity platform.
* Deploy and support multifactor authentication and passwordless initiatives across employed staff, credentialed providers, contractors, and students.
* Support badge\-tap / fast user switching for clinical workstations (e.g., Imprivata OneSign) in coordination with desktop engineering.
* Maintain role\-based access models at the directory and group level; remediate access creep and orphaned or stale accounts.
* Run periodic access certification campaigns; produce evidence for HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and internal audit requests.
* Administer privileged access management for admin and service accounts, including vaulting, rotation, and session monitoring.
* Manage non\-employee identity: vendors, travelers, locum tenens providers, students, and affiliate users outside the HR feed.
* Monitor and investigate identity\-related security events; support incident response and inappropriate\-access investigations with Security and Privacy/Compliance.
* Document standards, runbooks, and workflows; contribute to the IAM roadmap and automation backlog.


**Requirements**
* 3–5\+ years in identity and access management or systems administration with a heavy identity focus.
* Deep hands\-on expertise with Active Directory and Entra ID in a hybrid environment.
* Working knowledge of SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.
* Experience deploying MFA and conditional access at enterprise scale.
* PowerShell scripting for AD/Entra automation and reporting.
* Experience supporting audits and access reviews in a regulated environment.
* Understanding of least\-privilege and HIPAA “minimum necessary” principles.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a hospital or health system IT environment.
* IGA platform experience (SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta Identity Governance, or similar).
* PAM tooling (CyberArk, Delinea).
* Imprivata OneSign or comparable clinical SSO.
* HR\-to\-identity integration experience (Workday, UKG, or Oracle HCM feeds).
* Certifications: SC\-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator), Security\+, CISSP, or CIDPRO.


**What This Role Is Not**
 This position does not include Epic or other EHR application security build. Candidates will not manage Epic security classes, templates, or user records — that function is owned by the clinical applications team.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 Hybrid/on\-site per organizational policy; participation in an on\-call rotation for identity\-impacting incidents (account lockouts affecting clinical operations, termination escalations).

 We are looking for a Robotics Simulation Engineer to join our robotics software team, building the simulation environments used to develop and validate next\-generation autonomous mobile robot platforms for industrial mobility applications. In this role, you will model robots, sensors, and physical interactions in a physics\-based 3D simulation environment, and keep that simulation in step with our robot software stack.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working close to both software and hardware — reproducing real\-world robot behaviour in simulation, and giving the navigation, perception, and control teams a fast, reliable place to test before anything runs on a physical robot.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Build and maintain robot simulations and representative industrial environments.
* Import and configure robot models from CAD and URDF, including meshes, joints, collision geometry, and physical properties.
* Configure simulated sensors such as LiDAR, RGB/depth cameras, and IMUs.

* Develop Python scripts and tools to automate scene creation, simulation execution, and data collection.
* Create representative scenarios involving obstacles, different surfaces, facility layouts, and moving objects.
* Debug simulation issues related to robot motion, physics, sensors, and software integration.
* Collaborate with hardware and software teams to compare simulated behaviour with real robot performance.
* Optimize simulation performance and maintain reusable assets, configurations, and documentation.
* Support regression testing and reproduction of issues observed during physical robot trials.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's or master's in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–5 years of experience in robotics simulation or robotics software development.
* Hands\-on experience with a physics\-based 3D robotics simulation platform such as Isaac Sim, and proficiency in Python.
* Working knowledge of robotics middleware and robot software integration.
* Familiarity with URDF and OpenUSD for importing and configuring robot assets.
* Understanding of robot kinematics, coordinate transformations, rigid\-body physics, collision modelling, and sensor simulation.
* Experience with Linux and Git, and strong debugging, problem\-solving, and communication skills.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Experience with autonomous mobile robots and navigation systems.
* Familiarity with robot navigation stacks, SLAM, and perception pipelines.
* Experience with Blender, SolidWorks, FreeCAD, or similar modelling tools.
* Familiarity with synthetic data generation and domain randomization.
* Exposure to automated simulation testing, CI workflows, or multi\-robot simulation.

Genuine familiarity with PlayStation consoles is essential, and familiarity with Xbox is preferred \- this can come from console development experience or simply from being an engaged player who understands how these platforms work from a customer perspective.
 



  





 This role suits someone who enjoys taking existing games and getting them ready for console audiences, is genuinely into console gaming, and can collaborate effectively with a remote team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Port and adapt existing, indie\-developed games for release on PlayStation and Xbox consoles, meeting platform\-specific technical and certification requirements.
* Develop and implement game features, mechanics, and interactive experiences as needed, alongside the porting work.
* Work with GameMaker Studio 2, Unreal Engine, or similar game development platforms to build, adapt, and maintain game projects.
* Translate game concepts and requirements into functional and engaging gameplay experiences.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-structured code.
* Debug, test, and resolve gameplay, technical, and performance issues, including console\-specific issues that arise during porting.
* Collaborate with designers, artists, indie developer partners, and other team members to deliver console\-ready builds.
* Integrate game assets, animations, audio, UI elements, and other required components.
* Optimise gameplay and technical performance for console hardware.
* Review and evaluate games built by other, including indie, developers as part of the publishing and porting pipeline, providing technical and design feedback.
* Participate in testing, iteration, and refinement based on feedback and platform certification requirements.
* Maintain clear documentation and provide regular updates on porting and development progress.



  





**Requirements** 



* Proven experience porting or adapting games for console platforms (PlayStation and/or Xbox), or strong game development experience with a clear ability to learn console porting and certification processes.
* Genuine familiarity with PlayStation consoles (required) and Xbox consoles (preferred) — as a player or from a technical/customer perspective; being an active console gamer is a strong plus.
* Experience with, or exposure to, the PlayStation Partners or ID@Xbox developer programs is preferred but not required.
* Experience with GameMaker Studio 2, Unreal Engine, Unity, or a similar game development platform.
* Familiarity with GML (GameMaker Language), C\#, and/or Python — the primary languages used across the codebase.
* Good understanding of gameplay mechanics, game systems, debugging, and optimisation.
* Experience taking game features from concept through development, testing, and refinement.
* Ability to work with existing codebases, often built by other developers, and contribute to ongoing projects.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Experience reviewing or evaluating games or code built by other developers, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback.
* A portfolio, GitHub profile, playable game, or examples of previous game development or porting work is highly desirable.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Remote, part\-time working opportunity.
* Collaborative and supportive remote team environment.
* Opportunity to work on interesting games being published across PlayStation and Xbox

 We are looking for an Embedded \& Electronics Engineer who enjoys building real systems, not just prototypes.
 



  





 You will work across firmware, PCB design, sensors, motors, power systems and machine integration, taking electronic systems from concept through testing and into field deployment.

 ARL Farm — Bangalore Rural

 Please complete the application form provided in this job description carefully.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager \- Live Services** 




  





**About Us** 




 Liquidnitro Games is a game development company built to create, launch, and scale ambitious games for a global audience.
 



 Founded by industry veterans with deep experience across free\-to\-play, live services, and large\-scale game production agnostic of platforms, we bring together product thinking, design craft, engineering depth, art execution, data, and live operations under one roof.
 



 We build games from the ground up, take new ideas from 0 to 1, and work with select partners to strengthen, scale, and operate high\-quality game experiences. Our teams combine creative ownership with production discipline, helping projects move from early prototypes to validated products, and from launch to long\-term growth.
 



 At Liquidnitro, we are building the next generation of game teams, products, and tools from India for the global games industry.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager** 
 to join a team operating and growing a live game.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of players, product, data, design, and live operations. You will help understand how players engage with the game, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and work with cross\-functional teams to turn those insights into product changes, features, events, and experiments.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between data and gameplay, understanding both what the numbers are telling us and what is happening inside the game. The goal is not just to report performance, but to understand why players behave the way they do and what we should do next.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Analyse player behaviour across retention, engagement, progression, monetization, and live events.
* Build a strong understanding of the game's core loop, progression systems, economy, content, and player segments.
* Identify product opportunities and translate them into clear hypotheses and recommendations.
* Work closely with Product Management, Game Design, Analytics, Production, Engineering, and other cross functional teams to improve the game.
* Support the design and evaluation of features, events, offers, progression changes, and monetization initiatives.
* Define success metrics for product changes and evaluate performance after launch.
* Design and analyse A/B tests and other experiments.
* Use cohort and segmentation analysis to understand differences in player behaviour.
* Investigate changes in KPIs and identify the underlying causes rather than stopping at surface\-level reporting.
* Review the performance of live events and features and recommend changes based on player behaviour and outcomes.
* Track competitive games, market trends, and relevant product mechanics.
* Contribute to product roadmap and live\-ops planning based on player needs, game performance, and business priorities.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both product and development teams.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management – preferably in gaming or consumer related products.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work with data and convert analysis into actionable product decisions.
* Understanding of free\-to\-play game metrics such as retention, engagement, conversion, ARPDAU, and LTV.
* Strong interest in games and a good instinct for player experience.
* Ability to think in hypotheses, test assumptions, and measure outcomes.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and communicating with both creative and technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and curiosity about why systems and players behave the way they do.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience working on a live mobile or free\-to\-play game.
* Working knowledge of SQL and BI or analytics tools.
* Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis, and player segmentation.
* Understanding of game economies, progression systems, rewards, and monetization.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 You are able to move beyond reporting that a metric changed and explain why it changed, which players were affected, what part of the game caused it, and what we should do next.
 



 Over time, you should develop enough understanding of the game and its players to independently identify product opportunities, build a case for them using data and player insight, and help drive them from hypothesis through implementation and measurement.

The platform also includes structured AI interviews, role\-specific assessments, candidate verification, and recruitment automation for a wide range of roles and hiring volumes. By unifying sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment, and verification, Pakt enables modern, efficient, and scalable talent acquisition.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Information Technology Product Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for defining and owning product vision and roadmaps for Pakt’s AI hiring and ATS solutions, with a focus on IT and platform capabilities. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include gathering and prioritizing business and technical requirements, translating user needs into clear product specifications, and collaborating closely with engineering, design, data, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality product releases. The Product Manager will analyze product performance and user behavior, run experiments, and use data to guide feature enhancements and new initiatives. The role also involves managing stakeholder expectations, coordinating product launches, and ensuring that Pakt’s technology solutions remain reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Product Management skills, including roadmap ownership, requirement definition, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Solid Information Technology background, with understanding of SaaS platforms, APIs, data systems, and technical constraints.
* Demonstrated Analytical Skills to interpret data, evaluate product performance, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Experience working with Business Requirements and Business Process design, mapping user journeys and optimizing workflows.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Prior experience in B2B SaaS, HR tech, recruitment software, or AI/ML\-powered products is highly beneficial.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and drive alignment.
* Proven track record of delivering products from concept to launch in an agile environment.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and 30,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



  





**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** 




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud.* 




  





 The Scrum Master at Cvent (SM) facilitates processes, escalates impediments, manages risk, and helps to drive continuous improvement at the team level. The scrum master acts as a servant leader to the team and promotes scrum best practices and coaches the team to track and constantly improves its velocity. The Scrum Master is expected to handle 2\-3 Sprint teams as a Scrum Master.
 



  





**Position Duties** 



* Helps to establish sprint cadence.
* Coordinates with product owners to keep the sprint team’s backlog ready and groomed.
* Facilitates sprint planning, review, daily scrum, refinement meetings, and retrospective events at the team level.
* Publishes committed sprint objectives.
* Identifies and escalates impediments.
* Manage team or project level risks and issues and take corrective actions to mitigate them, develop mitigation strategies and support the teams in addressing challenges.
* Maintains relevant metrics to help the team monitor their performance.
* Coordinates elements of the sprint plan with other technology staff outside of the project.
* Take responsibility for managing dependencies within the sprint team as well as those dependencies from other development or operations teams.
* Participates as well as facilitate Scrum of Scrums.
* Encourages Architect, UX, QT and Sprint team collaboration.
* Coordinates timely response and support to production line customer issues and helps to ensure that team maintains adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Facilitate Project / Epic estimation process.
* Identify and promote opportunities for integrating AI tools and automation into team processes for improved efficiency (e.g., backlog refinement, reporting, estimation, or retrospective analysis).
* Documentation and Reporting: Maintain project documentation such as sprint plans, burndown charts, and crucial project documents like the Risk Register and Project Charter. Provide regular updates on project progress to stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders regarding project progress and deliverables, ensuring they are informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Actively encourage and guide the team in applying AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve sprint predictability, and address bottlenecks.
* Communicates sprint/team or project status to stakeholders at a fixed cadence.
* Coordinate work teams consisting of R\&D / SRE / Cloud Operations / blended teams using agile methodologies.
* Promotes adherence to Agile software development best practices.
* Ensure team members have the necessary resources to complete their tasks.
* Ensure that sprint team deliverables meet the required quality standards.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives at the team level.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to identify and resolve issues.
* Acts as an Agile coach to the development team.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* 4\-7 years of technical experience including 2\-5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.
* Understanding backlog tracking, burn down metrics, velocity, task definition, and other Agile terminology.
* Large/enterprise application development experience using Agile methodologies preferred but not required.
* Strong leadership, time management, conflict resolution, and analytical skills.
* Able to act as servant leader at the team level or project level.
* Situational Awareness \- Must be the first to notice differences and issues as they arise, make all necessary attempts to solve them before elevating them to management.
* Drive for continuous improvement.
* Quick learner \- Must be able to quickly gain high level understanding of the technical and business domains of the development team.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-powered productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., AI meeting assistants, reporting bots, AI Agents, Glean, backlog analyzers etc.) is a must have.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI\-driven solutions for workflow improvement.
* Self\-motivation and the ability to work under minimal supervision are a must.
* Outstanding written and oral communication.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and techniques will be an added advantage.
* Experience with Atlassian Tools such as Jira and Confluence preferred but not required.
* Experience and knowledge of PI planning will be an added advantage.
* Experience in project management will be an added advantage.

title: Software Engineer (Fullstack), Collections
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**About Us**
 The Collections team owns some of the most foundational features of the Postman platform like Collections, Documentation, and Version Control. These are the building blocks that developers around the world rely on every day to design, test, and deploy APIs. The services powering these features operate at massive scale, and with that scale comes a constant stream of hard engineering problems, from data consistency and storage efficiency to system reliability and performance under heavy load. In addition, the team works on evolving the product through new features shaped by real user needs.
   

  

****The Role****
 We're looking for a Software Engineer who is energized by the challenges that come with scale. If you enjoy solving complex problems that don't have easy answers, have a bias for action, and want to help shape how a high\-scale platform is engineered end to end, this role is for you. You'll also help shape where the product goes next, building experiences used by millions of developers.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Own and build secure, performant, and scalable end\-to\-end experiences for Postman, tackling day\-to\-day challenges around scale, performance, and reliability.
* Work with agility. Move quickly, make pragmatic trade\-offs, and iterate fast to deliver incremental improvements.
* Improve quality and reliability by strengthening test pipelines, and proactively addressing bottlenecks and technical debt.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver solutions that meet both technical and user needs.
* Help define and drive engineering best practices including code quality, system design standards, and operational excellence, while contributing to the engineering culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring peers.
* Contribute to new features and product improvements driven by user needs and innovation, including quickly building functional prototypes for internal and external use\-cases.


****What We’re Looking For****
* 2\-4 years of experience, with a track record of building and shipping features at scale.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js and databases (SQL/NoSQL) which preferably includes query optimization and schema design.
* Strong Computer Science fundamentals \- algorithms, networking, and operating systems, along with a genuine curiosity for solving scale\-related challenges.
* A strong sense of ownership and agility. You see problems through from design to production and get things done even under ambiguity or constraints.
* A collaborative mindset. You communicate well, work confidently across teams, and can challenge stakeholders like PMs and EMs when needed.
* An appreciation for product thinking. You love translating user needs into technical solutions and building things that create real value for users.
* A commitment to writing testable, maintainable code, paired with a curiosity to learn new things and explore beyond silos.


****Why Join Us?****
* Build for millions. Work on a high\-velocity team shaping the systems that power Postman for developers around the world.
* Solve problems that actually matter. Scale, reliability, distributed systems \- every day brings a new challenge worth sinking your teeth into.
* Own it, end to end. Be part of a culture that values curiosity, ownership, trust, and winning together, even under constraints.
* We've got you covered. Competitive salary and benefits, a flexible schedule, and real room to grow.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a thoughtful, detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our website and digital experiences from one of our India office locations. You will design intuitive, on\-brand experiences from wireframe through high\-fidelity mockup, working closely with web, marketing, and product marketing teams to bring ideas to life.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design role for someone who enjoys solving user problems through clean, purposeful design and who wants to see their work built and shipped quickly. You will work closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Design \& Delivery**
* Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI for web pages, landing pages, and digital experiences in Figma.
* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows and information architecture.
* Design and iterate on landing pages and campaign assets in support of marketing and demand generation initiatives.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by designing test variants for key pages and conversion flows.


**Design Systems \& Consistency**
* Create and maintain a design system and component library to ensure visual consistency across the site.
* Apply Candescent brand standards consistently across all digital work, including typography, colour, iconography, and imagery.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices (WCAG) and are optimised for performance.


**Research \& Validation**
* Conduct or contribute to user research and usability testing, and gather feedback to inform design decisions.
* Use analytics and test results to identify usability problems and prioritise improvements.
* Stay current on design trends, tools, and best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the team.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Collaborate closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively, and support a clean handoff.
* Partner with stakeholders across marketing, product marketing, and sales to gather requirements and present design concepts.
* Present and explain design decisions clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably for web or digital marketing.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and prototyping.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, typography, and layout skills.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and designing for multiple breakpoints and devices.
* Working knowledge of UX best practices, user flows, and information architecture.
* Ability to translate business and marketing goals into clear, user\-centred design solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of visual polish and consistency.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Hands\-on experience building or editing sites in Webflow is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how designs translate to code is preferred.
* Experience with user research or usability testing methods is a plus.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation principles is a plus.
* Experience designing for SEO\-friendly page structures is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Designs are intuitive, on\-brand, and elevate the overall user experience.
* Design\-to\-development handoff is smooth, with minimal rework needed.
* A well\-maintained, scalable design system that speeds up future work.
* Measurable improvements in usability and conversion on redesigned pages.
* Stakeholders receive clear rationale for design decisions, not just deliverables.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Genuine curiosity about how users behave, and willingness to let evidence change the design.
* Comfort designing within an established brand system rather than starting from a blank page.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Portfolio Submission**
*Required with every application*
 A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed. Please include a link to an online portfolio or an attached PDF, with access credentials if the work is password protected, along with three to five selected pieces that best demonstrate your web and digital design work. For each piece, include a short note describing the brief, your specific contribution, and the outcome.
   

  

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.
