title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Associate Software Engineer (Backend) — Digital Platform \& Engineering** 




**Location:** 
 Noida (work from office, 5 days a week)
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years
 



**Team:** 
 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE)
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Engineering Manager, DPE
 



  





**Who we are** 




 Over the past 17 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world\-class multi\-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cyber City \& Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta continues to expand its healthcare ecosystem through diagnostics, pharmacies, homecare services and digital health initiatives.
 



 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE) is Medanta's newly built product and technology organization. Modelled on India's leading internet companies, DPE brings together product managers, designers and engineers to build the products and platforms that power patient journeys, clinical care and hospital operations across the Medanta network. We work from our own office in Noida, with strong sponsorship from the CEO and the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for Associate Software Engineers with strong computer science fundamentals and early hands\-on experience of how real software gets built, reviewed and shipped. You will build backend services and APIs that doctors, nurses and patients rely on every day.
 



 This is a role for engineers who want to learn fast in a small, high\-calibre team. You will work alongside experienced engineering managers and senior engineers, with engineering levels and practices modelled on India's top product companies. We move with startup energy, but in healthcare quality is non\-negotiable, so you will learn to build software that is fast to ship and safe to trust.
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 



* **Seamless patient journeys** 
 — the services behind finding the right doctor, booking a visit, diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow\-up across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care.
* **Products that empower clinicians and caregivers** 
 — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads.
* **Platform\-first foundations** 
 — reusable services such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
* **Voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences** 
 — backends for products where people speak instead of type, tap instead of filling forms, and are assisted by AI at every step.
* **A Hospital Information System built from scratch** 
 — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow.
* **Intelligence and interoperability** 
 — AI\-powered services, healthcare data platforms, and integrations with national digital health standards such as ABDM and FHIR.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test and ship backend services and APIs in Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI), with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write clean, well\-tested and maintainable code; take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
* Understand the components of the systems you work on — databases, caches such as Redis, message queues such as Kafka — and why each is used.
* Model data and write efficient queries on relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Debug and fix issues across development and production, and contribute to monitoring and reliability.
* Work closely with product managers, designers and senior engineers to understand requirements and the clinical workflows behind them, including occasional visits to our hospitals.
* Ask questions, think independently, and constructively challenge designs when something does not add up.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents throughout development — planning, implementing, testing and refactoring — while owning every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it.
* Follow secure coding and data\-privacy practices for systems that handle patient data — audit trails, role\-based access control and encryption of sensitive data, in line with regulations such as the DPDP Act — and strict guardrails so patient information is never exposed to unapproved AI tools.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




***Must have***



* 1–2 years of software development experience at a product company, startup or technology services company, with exposure to a real development workflow — version control, code reviews, testing and deployments.
* Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, object\-oriented programming, databases, and operating systems and networking basics.
* Proficiency in Java or Python.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in day\-to\-day development — writing effective prompts, breaking tasks down for an agent, and rigorously reviewing and testing what it produces.
* A clear understanding of the project you currently work on — its design, the components used, and the reasons behind those choices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to explain your thinking clearly while solving a problem.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* A builder's mindset: excited to build from the ground up, comfortable with ambiguity, and keen to take ownership.
* A product mindset — curiosity about how hospitals work, and care for the outcome for the user, not just the ticket.
* Depth over frequent switches — we value engineers who have stayed long enough in a role to learn from it.



***Good to have***



* Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot or FastAPI.
* Exposure to Redis, Kafka, or other caching and messaging systems.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Internships, open\-source contributions, or side projects that have been used by real users.
* Personal or internship projects that use LLM APIs or build simple agents.
* Competitive programming experience.
* Exposure to frontend development (React).



  





**Education** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or a related field from a top\-tier institution (IITs, IIITs, NITs, BITS or equivalent).



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice\-first and AI\-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
* Learn in a small, flat, high\-calibre team, with close access to engineering leadership and the Chief Digital Officer.
* An engineering bar and career ladder modelled on India's top product companies, with a clear path for growth.
* See your code used by doctors, nurses and patients — and work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians.
* Access to the latest AI coding tools, and a team that is rethinking how software gets built.
* A tech\-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open\-door leadership.
* The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Full Stack Developer** 




  





 📍
 **Gurgaon** 




**· Full\-time** 




 · Level: Open, we hire the right person first, then decide the level
 



  





**About Enrich Labs** 




  





 We're a venture studio, and we build the products that sales, marketing, and GTM teams run their outreach and operations on. Everything we ship is our own. Three products are live and growing: InboxKit for email infrastructure, Enrich.so for lead data, and our sending platform for running campaigns at volume. More than thousands of customers across the globe use them to find the right people, reach them, and keep the whole machine running.
 



  





 It looks simple on the outside, but it's a hard problem underneath. The infrastructure has to be right the first time, at scale, against systems we don't control, and a single mistake can take weeks to undo. Agencies and outbound teams trust us with infrastructure their business depends on.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You'll own features from start to finish, both the backend and the frontend. We're a small team, so if you build something, you're also the one who fixes it when it breaks.
 



  





 You'll also have a real say in what gets built. Not just picking up tickets, but helping plan what we ship next across the studio, testing it properly before it goes out, pushing it to production for 10,000\+ customers, and then staying with it long enough to know whether they actually got value from it. A feature that ships and nobody uses is a feature that failed.
 



  





 We're open on experience level. Someone junior who thinks clearly is more valuable to us than someone senior who's coasting.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 




  




* New features across our products, from a rough idea to something live in front of 10,000\+ customers, including the judgement call about whether it's worth building at all.
* 
* Automation that runs at scale, the systems that do in seconds what would otherwise take a customer days of manual setup.
* 
* Monitoring and reliability, catching problems before a customer notices, and sending alerts that are actually useful rather than noise.
* 
* The interfaces customers live in, dashboards and flows that make something genuinely complicated feel obvious.
* 
* Our public API and integrations, the webhooks and 24\+ tool connections customers build their workflows on.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* You understand how the internet actually works. This is the most important part of the job. You know how DNS, HTTP, proxies, and TLS work, and you understand why things load slowly. You can look at a network trace and figure out what happened, and you've fixed problems that needed this kind of knowledge, not just worked at a level above it.



  




* You're curious about how things break. You think about how a feature could be misused while you're still building it. Maybe you've done CTFs, bug bounties, or authorised security testing, or you just enjoy reading about how things went wrong elsewhere. If you've ever found a bug in someone else's product, you reported it the right way. That matters to us as much as the curiosity itself.



  




* You can build a full feature, start to finish. You've taken something from a blank file to a live product, and kept it running afterward. You're equally comfortable with backend and frontend work, and you don't need someone else to hand things off to you.



  




* You ask why before how. You talk about your work in terms of what it did for users, not just tasks you finished. You've said no to building something before, and you know how to cut scope to ship on time.



  




* You have good taste. You can look at a screen and say exactly what's wrong with it. You think about the boring parts too, the loading, the empty states, the errors, the slow connections, because that's where real products are tested.



  




* You build things on your own, just because you're curious. This isn't about how much free time you have. Plenty of great engineers have full lives outside work. We just want to see that curiosity somewhere.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), a good part of our product surface is built on it.
* 
* Next.js or similar modern frontend tools, actually built with them, not just read about them.
* 
* Better Auth, or real work with logins, sessions, and tokens.
* 
* Golang, helpful for our backend, and easy to learn if you think clearly.
* 
* Browser automation like Playwright or Puppeteer, useful for a lot of our setup work.
* 
* None of these are dealbreakers. We'd rather hire someone with strong networking instincts and no Go experience than the other way around.



  





**What We Don't Care About** 




  





 Your degree, or not having one. Where you worked before. How many years you've used a specific tool. GitHub stars. Gaps in your resume. How smoothly you interview, we care about how clearly you think, not how polished you sound.
 



  





**To Apply** 




  





 Share something you've built, and one line on why you built it. A cover letter is optional. That one line isn't.
 



 Send it to
 **hiring@inboxkit.com** 




**Ashmeet@inboxkit.com**

title: Intern- Human Resource Operations
description:
**Intern \- HR Operations** 




 ThoughtSpot · Bangalore · 6\-Month Internship
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on internship within ThoughtSpot's People \& HR Operations team, designed for someone who wants to understand how a fast\-moving, global AI company keeps its people processes running. You will work across the full Hire\-to\-Retire lifecycle — from the moment a new hire joins to the day someone exits — handling the operational work that keeps the employee experience consistent and compliant.
 



 This is a great fit if you are detail\-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple tasks, and want real exposure to how HR Ops works at a Gartner Magic Quadrant\-recognised tech company.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




  





**1 · Onboarding \& New Hire Administration** 



* Prepare and send new hire welcome emails and Day 1 logistics information
* Create employee profiles in Rippling with all required fields
* Assign and track completion of new hire onboarding task lists in Rippling
* Send and track completion of new hire documentation: offer letter acknowledgement, policy sign\-offs, tax forms
* Coordinate IT provisioning requests for new hires: laptop, system access, tools
* Set up and administer new hire orientation sessions including scheduling and logistics
* Prepare region\-wise new hire checklists, add them to onboarding SOPs, and keep them updated
* Track Day 1 readiness checklist for all incoming hires and flag exceptions
* Monitor and follow up on incomplete onboarding tasks past the due date
* Maintain the new hire tracker and update status fields weekly



**2 · Offboarding \& Exit Administration** 



* Initiate offboarding workflows in Rippling on receipt of termination confirmation
* Send exit documentation packages to departing employees
* Track return of company assets: laptop, ID card, access cards
* Track completion of offboarding tasks and follow up on outstanding items
* Update employee status in Rippling post last working day
* Prepare region\-wise employee\-facing offboarding checklists, link them to existing SOPs, and keep them updated



**3 · Employee Data \& HR Transactions** 



* Process employee data change requests in Rippling: manager changes, title changes, department transfers, location updates
* Generate and send standard employment letters: verification of employment, compensation letters, experience letters
* Process probation confirmation updates in Rippling for non\-US employees
* Update employee records following approval of lifecycle changes
* Maintain the HR transactions tracker and update status on each request
* Follow up on pending approvals and incomplete data change requests



**4 · Compliance \& Audit Support** 



* Run regular audits of new hire task completion and flag non\-compliance
* Maintain and update compliance trackers for onboarding and offboarding
* Run a monthly audit to ensure 100% completion and acknowledgement of all mandatory HR policy sign\-offs and compliance requirements across all regions
* Maintain audit logs and ensure documentation is filed and accessible



**5 · Benefits Operations** 



* Manage additions and deletions of employee benefits data
* Handle first\-level employee benefits queries and escalate where needed
* Follow up with new joiners to ensure completion of benefits enrolment
* Ensure completion of nominations by new joiners
* Coordinate with insurers and brokers on employee queries and follow up through to resolution
* Guide employees through the GMC and OPD claims process and assist with claim rejections
* Manage documentation and system updates for Maternity Leave and Paternity Leave in India



**6 · Ticketing \& Employee Support** 



* Monitor the HR Jira board: triage new tickets, update status, and follow up on overdue items
* Respond to routine employee queries in the \#mypeople Slack channel
* Escalate complex or sensitive queries to senior HR Ops team members
* Log all employee interactions and resolutions in Jira for audit and reporting purposes
* Send acknowledgement and status update messages to employees on open tickets



  





**What You Bring:** 




  




* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field
* Strong attention to detail — you catch things before they become problems
* Comfortable working with tools like Google Sheets, Jira, and Slack — experience with Rippling is a plus
* Clear written communication: you can draft a professional email without much hand\-holding
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow up proactively without being reminded
* Discretion when handling sensitive and confidential employee information
* Eagerness to learn how HR Ops actually works inside a global tech company

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Talent Acquisition Intern** 
 to join our recruiting team and help us hire exceptional talent across both technical and non\-technical roles.
 



 You will work on some of the most challenging hiring problems in the Indian technology ecosystem, finding and evaluating candidates across AI research, computer vision, applied AI, geospatial technologies, signal processing, as well as business and other non\-technical functions.
 



 This is fundamentally a
 **recruiting role, not an engineering role** 
 .
 



 However, the people you recruit may include researchers and engineers working on problems at the level of advanced industry research and PhD\-level specialization, along with candidates across non\-technical functions.
 



 You are
 **not expected to already be a technical expert** 
 . We care much more about your ability to learn quickly.
 



 Over time, you will learn enough about the roles you hire for to conduct meaningful first\-round conversations with candidates across both technical and non\-technical functions.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Own recruiting pipelines from sourcing to offer for technical and non\-technical roles.
* Conduct structured first\-round interviews and learn how to evaluate candidates for highly specialized technical roles as well as non\-technical roles.
* Work directly with the founding team to refine sourcing strategies, interview questions, candidate profiles, and hiring standards.
* Take ownership of candidate experience and move strong candidates through the process quickly.



**Who We Are Looking For** 



* We are primarily looking for
 **undergraduate students of the 2026 batch** 
 .
* You do not need prior HR or recruiting experience.
* What matters much more is how you think.



**Strong Communication** 




 You can have clear, thoughtful conversations with people across very different levels of seniority, functions, and technical expertise.
 



**What We Are Not Looking For** 




 You do
 **not** 
 need:
 


* Previous HR experience.
* Previous recruiting experience.
* Expertise in every technical or non\-technical domain you will recruit for.
* Knowledge of traditional HR processes or frameworks.



 We are also not looking for someone who sees recruiting primarily as scheduling interviews, coordinating calendars, posting jobs, or moving candidates through an ATS.
 



 The core of this role is
 **finding exceptional people and developing the judgment required to evaluate them well** 
 .
 



**Why Join Auric AI** 



* Recruit for some of the most ambitious technical and non\-technical roles being built in India.
* Work directly with the founding team rather than inside a large HR organization.
* Competitive internship stipend with the opportunity to convert to a full\-time role based on performance.

 Reports to the

* Effective verbal and written communication skills accompanied with cultural sensitivity.
* Excellent planning, co\-ordination, and organizational skills.
* Strong process orientation. Use of the following tools may be required: Office Skills: telephones, data entry, HR related and office software to include, word processing, spread sheets, and presentation packages.
* Demonstrates advanced experience and skills associated with performing assigned HR functions that are of a diverse nature. Demonstrates advanced /thorough knowledge of the business segment and Flex business.
* Demonstrates expert knowledge of the HR function and a thorough understanding of Flex and related business entities. Demonstrates detailed knowledge of the complex functional areas of HR, is considered a technical expert in at least one of the functional areas and possesses a broad breadth of knowledge in other areas. Understands the strategic impact of the HR function across the organization.


**Scope / Impact:**
* Impacts the medium\-term (semi\-annual/annual) direction and operational success of the HR function. Helps to create functional processes and technologies. Executes and provides input to the functional HR strategic plans and objectives for the business segment and/or corporation. Demonstrates experience in leading major initiatives and provides input to those initiatives.


**Decision Making / Discretion:**
* Makes decisions for the function and the business segment. Decisions may affect multiple sites.


**Supervision / Leadership:**
* Recognizes and develops talent as a key element of executing operational business plans. Ensures Flex values are part of site work life. Provides strategic leadership for the function and the site.

description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager HRBP**
**GCL:E**
**Introduction To Role**
 At AstraZeneca we are guided in our work by a strong set of values, and we’re resetting expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. By truly following the science, we pioneer new methods, new thinking and bring unexpected teams together. From scientists to sales, lab techs to legal, we’re on a mission to turn ideas into life changing medicines that transform lives. We need great people who share our passion for science and have the drive and determination to meet the unmet needs of patients around the world. If you’re swift to action, confident to lead, willing to collaborate, and curious about what science can do, then you’re our kind of person.
   

  

 Are you ready to transform people strategies into measurable business outcomes that accelerate the delivery of life\-changing medicines? This role partners directly with senior leaders to shape workforce plans, elevate performance, and build a culture where bold ideas turn into real\-world impact for patients.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Contribute to and supports the execution of the business area’s strategic direction and HR agenda.
* Lead multidisciplinary HR projects across recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, people, employee relations, and change.
* Liaise with senior management to define business needs and tailor HR and employee relations solutions.
* Act as the main point of contact for complex HR policy issues, advice, and guidance.
* Guide, mentors, and challenges manager on the application of HR and employee relations practices.
* Ensure HR interventions are integrated, consistent, and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Drive and supports the development and implementation of cultural and organizational change plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies, collective agreements, and local employment laws.
* Monitor employee relations trends and resolves ER issues, managing risk and liaising with appropriate experts as needed.
* Review and analyze business unit data to identify trends and recommend solutions to improve performance, retention, and employee experience
* Plan, manage and provide continuous improvement to all aspects of the client organization and leadership review process and the strategic objectives therein. This includes both annual and any adhoc increases which focus on performance management and talent development.
* Nurture Performance Driven Culture \- Consult and Coach Managers on understanding AZ Performance Framework, Driving Performance Discussions and Addressing Underperformance.
* Lead Pulse Survey \& Culture transformation agenda – Ensuring employee participation, Focus Group discussion with employees on Pulse Insights, Action Planning with Leadership basis FGDs and Pulse insights, Handholding Leaders in driving action plan implementation and progress.
* Plan and steer employee engagement initiatives to promote synergies and spirit of camaraderie amongst employees (Employee Connect, Leadership, People Manager Connect).


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* 10\+ Years post qualification HR experience with minimum 6 years in Business partnering
* Postgraduate Degree/MBA in HR from Institute of repute.
* Excellent business insight and the ability to think and act strategically in the deployment of HR interventions
* Ability to design and deliver HR solutions in line with business priorities
* Ability to build \& forge strong relationships with collaborators and the ability to influence change
* Should continually look for opportunity areas \& challenge the status quo to enhance efficiency \& effectiveness
* Excellent communication skills, detailed oriented \& organized
* Demonstrate AZ values consistently
* AI and Digital HR Proficiency


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience partnering within IT/ITES and global matrix environments.
* Shown delivery of large\-scale organizational change using design thinking and agile methodologies.
* Sophisticated proficiency with HR analytics platforms and visualization tools.
* Depth in employee relations across multiple jurisdictions and compensation planning.
* Coaching credentials or certifications in organisational change, ER, or OD.


 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
   

  

**Why AstraZeneca**
 Join a distributed team that fuels the enterprise with insight, innovation, and courage. Unexpected teams share the same space, fueling bold thinking that directly improves how we serve patients. We blend mission with momentum, using digital innovation and data\-driven decisions to simplify, modernize, and scale smarter ways of working. Here, entrepreneurial spirit is real: you’ll own ideas, make quick, ethical decisions, and see your work ripple across the organization. We value courtesy alongside ambition and provide the support, networks, and autonomy you need to stretch, grow, and build an unrivalled reputation while making a relevant difference.
   

  

 Bring your bold HR leadership to AstraZeneca and turn ambition into impact—step forward today to shape a high\-performing, patient\-focused future!

 17\-Sept\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 08\-Oct\-2026

 Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy.  with a focus on customer service and assures alignment with HR "Centers of Expertise" (COEs) and other stakeholders such as field HR and HR Business Partners.  Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field

title: HR Associate
description:
**About Arbolus**
 Arbolus is the next\-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.
   

  

 At the core of our platform is the world's largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world's leading software assets.
   

  

 Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech\-driven approach that delivers high\-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market\-first automated Q\&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.
   

  

 Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture\-backed scale\-up with 170\+ employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, New York and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The People team sits right at the core of Arbolus and is responsible for attracting, supporting and retaining the talent that powers our business worldwide.
   

  

 As an Associate in the People team, you will work across the full employee life cycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management and offboarding — partnering with hiring managers to bring great people into the business and supporting them throughout their time with us. You will also play a hands\-on role in building the culture of our Gurgaon hub, from engagement initiatives to the day\-to\-day moments that make Arbolus a place people want to stay.
   

  

 This is a broad, generalist role with real ownership from day one, and plenty of room to grow as we scale.
   

  

**What You'll Be In Charge Of**
* Managing employee life cycle activities including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, training, performance management, and compensation and benefits administration
* Partnering with hiring managers to write job descriptions, run interviews and hire the right people for our teams
* Planning and running employee engagement activities — celebrations, team events, wellbeing initiatives and culture\-building moments across the Gurgaon office
* Owning the grievance redressal process, handling employee concerns with care and ensuring timely resolution
* Analysing HR metrics to spot trends and improvement areas across engagement, attrition and performance appraisals
* Collaborating with stakeholders in India and globally to implement People strategies that support business objectives


**About You**
 We're looking for curious and ambitious people who are eager to learn, take ownership and contribute to Arbolus' growth. You enjoy working with people, you're organised enough to keep several things moving at once, and you're comfortable handling sensitive conversations with discretion.
   

  

**Requirements To Succeed In This Role**
* 1–2 years of overall HR experience
* Hands\-on experience with recruitment and broader HR responsibilities
* Exposure to the entire employee life cycle (hire to retire)
* Proficiency using an ATS
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to handle confidential information discreetly


**Nice to have**
* Previous experience in a start\-up or fast\-paced environment
* Experience organising employee engagement or culture initiatives
* Intellectual curiosity and a genuine desire to learn


**What We Offer**
* Annual performance\-based bonus on top of your base salary
* 25 days of paid time off per year, plus all local bank holidays
* Comprehensive health insurance and gym membership
* Top\-notch equipment to keep your work efficient and smooth
* Free coffee, tea, snacks and lunch to keep your energy up through the day
* Regular social activities run by our local Social Committees


*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
*Arbolus is committed to providing reasonable adjustments for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If, due to a disability, you need assistance or adjustment in completing your application please email us at* 
*talent@arbolus.com* 
*. Please put "Reasonable Adjustment" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. Please note that this inbox is not monitored for application status update requests.*
*We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. All job applicants must be authorised to work for any employer in the country where the position is indicated to be based.*

**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:**

**Did you know?**

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. Lead offer construction and closure for senior hires, with awareness of US compensation norms where relevant. Manage recruiting capacity including agency relationships.
 



  





**Compensation and equity** 




 Run the compensation cycle end to end \- benchmarking, band construction, moderation, approval and communication \- with fluency in both India and US market benchmarks. Administer the ESOP programme: grant recommendations, board cadence, documentation and employee communication.
 



  





**Benefits and people operations** 




 Design and roll out benefits including retirement schemes and insurance for the India population, while coordinating with US\-side HR/legal on benefits parity and obligations where applicable. Own payroll governance and vendor performance across employee and contractor populations, onboarding, leave and holiday framework, and HRIS data integrity and access governance.
 



  





**Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Own worker classification policy and risk assessment across engagement models in both countries. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

**Key Responsibilities**
 Provide analytical support to one or more functional areas Use common processes tools, and information systems to enable supply chain analysis. Ensure data integrity of all analytics and reports. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Participate in six sigma and supply chain improvement projects Use existing business systems to provide analytics and reporting that are capable and repeatable.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Materials Planning System Utilization \- Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long\-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day\-to\-day operations.
   

  

 Plan for Every Part (PFEP) \- Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
   

  

 Analysis and Troubleshooting \- Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.
   

  

 Inventory Management and Optimization \- Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end\-to\-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
   

  

 Material Planning \- Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.
   

  

 Materials KPI Management \- Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end\-customer impact; strategically balances trade\-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

 College, university, or equivalent degree required.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

 Minimal to intermediate level of experience required.

* Ability to connect and work with multiple data sources
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Good project management \& communication skills to interact with cross\-functional teams

* Deploy model\-backed services and troubleshoot them in realistic workloads.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Python skills.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch and modern neural\-network architectures.
* Understanding of transformers, tokenisation, embeddings, attention, sampling, and decoding.
* Ability to write maintainable software beyond notebooks.
* Comfortable working with Linux, Git, Docker, APIs, and basic cloud infrastructure.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills.


**Useful ML systems knowledge**
**You Should Understand, Or Be Motivated To Learn**
* model serving and inference;
* vLLM or similar runtimes;
* continuous batching and KV caching;
* quantisation;
* throughput vs latency trade\-offs;
* GPU memory constraints;
* mixed precision and device placement;
* profiling and out\-of\-memory debugging;
* structured/constrained generation.


 Experience with CUDA, Triton, distributed systems, Kubernetes, NCCL, or low\-level optimisation is useful but
 **not required** 
 .
   

  

**What We Look For**

**Good Evidence Includes**
* a substantial ML or systems project;
* research or thesis work;
* reproducing or implementing a research paper;
* open\-source contributions;
* building or profiling an inference/training system;

description:
**About Signant Health** 




  





 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




  





 Signant Health is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Accelerated Development to build AI\-powered, agentic features into our clinical trial platforms. Working across the .NET stack, you will take AI capabilities from backend LLM integration through to a usable front\-end — designing agents and agentic workflows, not just prompting a model. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high\-impact environment. We weigh the depth of your AI and agentic build experience more heavily than years of general experience: a developer with one to three years of substantive, hands\-on agentic work is exactly the profile we are targeting.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function** 




  




* 1\-5 Years of experience in AI, .NET and Fullstack.
* Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows — tool\-use/function calling, multi\-step task orchestration, and agent loops — that power Signant Health's clinical trial platforms.
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI) into .NET application code, handling authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Deliver AI features end\-to\-end, taking them from backend integration through to a usable, production\-ready front\-end.
* Build custom agents and tools with the Claude Agent SDK, wiring and steering agent loops.
* Author custom skills and slash commands for Claude Code to codify team\-specific workflows.
* Implement RAG pipelines and integrate vector stores (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone) to ground agent outputs in trusted data.
* Instrument agents for evaluation and observability so their outputs can be verified, measured, and audited.
* Apply AI\-specific risk controls appropriate to a regulated clinical environment, addressing hallucination, determinism, and auditability of agent decisions.
* Use Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) daily as a primary development tool, reviewing and steering AI\-generated diffs.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Full\-stack .NET development — C\#/ASP.NET Core on the backend paired with a modern front\-end framework.
* Hands\-on agentic development experience — building AI agents or agentic workflows (tool\-use/function calling, multi\-step task orchestration, agent loops); not just prompting an LLM, but building systems around one.
* Practical LLM API integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI), including authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Proven full\-stack delivery of AI features — able to take an agentic/AI feature from backend integration through to a usable front\-end, not just a notebook prototype.
* Daily, hands\-on use of Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) as a primary development tool — comfortable working through multi\-step agentic sessions and reviewing and steering AI\-generated diffs, rather than occasional autocomplete\-style use.
* Prompt engineering — designing and iterating on system prompts as production software contracts, not one\-off experiments.
* Python proficiency as the preferred language for AI/agent tooling; comfort with async patterns a plus.
* Evaluation and observability literacy — able to reason about whether an agent's output is correct and instrument it to prove so.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Claude Agent SDK experience — building custom agents, defining tools, and wiring agent loops.
* Working knowledge of agent primitives: hooks (deterministic pre/post\-tool\-call controls), skills (progressive\-disclosure, load\-on\-demand instructions), subagents/multi\-agent delegation, and session/state management.
* Experience authoring custom skills or slash commands for Claude Code to codify team\-specific workflows.
* Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to internal tools and data sources.
* Working knowledge of RAG patterns and vector store integration (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone).
* Awareness of AI\-specific risk areas relevant to a regulated environment (OWASP LLM Top 10, hallucination/determinism concerns, and auditability of agent decisions).



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



  





 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



  





 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



  





 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
 



  





 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

 BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a hands\-on AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and innovation of AI capabilities within our enterprise\-grade AI platform — a secure, internal environment offering services such as document translation, intelligent chatbots, LLM APIs, and other AI\-powered workflows.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and applied AI/ML solutions — from ideation and rapid prototyping, through
 **model training and fine\-tuning where needed, to inference and production deployment** 
 in collaboration with engineering teams. While our preferred deployment environment is
 **Azure** 
 , the role is not strictly cloud\-native; we value engineers who can deliver robust AI solutions across diverse stacks. This role blends deep technical expertise with product thinking to deliver tangible business value through AI.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Solution Design \& Development**
* Design, prototype, and validate AI\-powered features spanning Generative AI, NLP, and Agentic AI use cases.
* Train, fine\-tune, and evaluate language or vision models where pre\-built or hosted models are insufficient — and operationalize them for inference in production.
* Architect and deliver production\-ready, large\-document advanced RAG workflows, including chunking strategies, hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, and evaluation.
* Build complex multi\-agent systems — designing reusable, composable agent capabilities (skills, tools, actions) that can be dynamically invoked by LLMs.
* Implement agent interoperability and orchestration using protocols such as Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A), Agent Communication Protocol (ACP), and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Develop modular, reusable Python APIs and reference implementations for use cases including chatbots, document Q\&A, summarization, and intelligent automation.
* Apply prompt engineering, context engineering, and solution tuning to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.


**Deployment \& Optimization**
* Provide well\-documented proof\-of\-concepts and reference implementations to Full Stack and DevOps teams for integration and deployment.
* Collaborate with backend and cloud engineers to ensure AI solutions meet performance, cost, and security constraints.
* Build and optimize inference pipelines; monitor token usage, latency, and model performance, recommending improvements across the stack.


**Product Innovation \& Evangelism**
* Act as an internal AI product evangelist — identifying, championing, and prototyping new AI\-powered use cases.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to shape AI product concepts and contribute to roadmap development.
* Lead internal PoCs, technical demos, and feasibility assessments.
* Stay current with the evolving AI landscape and evaluate emerging tools, models, and techniques for adoption.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 2–4 years in applied AI/ML engineering, with demonstrated delivery of production Generative and Agentic AI solutions.
* Ability to build AI solutions across Generative AI and Agentic AI, including training and fine\-tuning language models when required and deploying them for inference.
* Proven experience building Agentic AI systems — multi\-agent orchestration, reusable agent skills/tools, and agent interoperability (A2A, ACP, MCP).
* Hands\-on experience designing and shipping advanced RAG pipelines in production — including hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, query transformation, and systematic evaluation — over large, unstructured document collections.
* Hands\-on experience building and orchestrating agent skills — authoring and managing reusable skill definitions (e.g., skills.md/Claude Skills\-style capability files) that can be dynamically discovered and invoked by LLMs.
* Experience building custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — exposing tools, resources, and data sources to LLMs/agents through standardized, interoperable interfaces.
* Proven experience building entity extraction and document understanding solutions at scale across diverse, unstructured document formats.
* Practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks and vector/retrieval systems (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel; FAISS, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search — or equivalents).
* Strong proficiency in Python, including API development (FastAPI/Flask), async/concurrent programming, data wrangling, and rapid prototyping (Streamlit, Gradio, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience integrating at least one major LLM provider (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Hugging Face, Cohere, Meta Llama).
* Solid grasp of prompt engineering, context engineering, and latency\-vs\-cost trade\-offs.
* Working familiarity with the Azure AI ecosystem (Azure AI Studio/Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services such as Vision, Translator, and Document Intelligence) — or willingness to ramp up quickly.
* Experience with the Anthropic/Claude ecosystem (Claude Skills, Claude Code, Agent SDK).
* Familiarity with fine\-tuning and model optimization techniques (PEFT, LoRA, quantization, distillation, pruning).


**Preferred Qualifications( Good To Have)**
* Experience with experiment tracking and evaluation tools (e.g., LangSmith, MLflow)
* Familiarity with deep learning / classical ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-learn) and CV/NLP toolkits (Transformers, spaCy, OpenCV), and exposure to computer vision (image classification, object detection, segmentation) where appropriate — a plus, not mandatory.
* A strong track record in Kaggle competitions, AI/ML hackathons, or similar applied challenges is a definite plus.


**Collaboration \& Integration**
* Partner with Full Stack Developers to translate AI capabilities into usable, well\-documented APIs.
* Coordinate with DevOps and Cloud Engineers to align AI features with infrastructure, security, and deployment requirements.
* Participate in design reviews and planning sessions to ensure smooth handoff of AI features into production.


**What You'll Bring**
* A builder's mindset — you turn ideas into working prototypes quickly.
* Full\-spectrum capability — you pick the right approach (GenAI, agents, deep learning, or classical ML) for the problem at hand, and can train or fine\-tune models when off\-the\-shelf won't do.
* Product intuition — you think beyond code and understand business impact.
* Collaborative spirit — you communicate clearly across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams.
* Curiosity — you stay ahead of the rapidly evolving GenAI and Agentic AI landscape.


 Why Join Us?

title: AI Engineering Intern
description:
**Company Description**
 Abstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI\-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack — from deploying and evaluating private and open\-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them.
   

  

 Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the
 **AI layer** 
 , focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the
 **application layer** 
 , focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Context**
 Using an AI model through an API is very different from deploying and operating AI systems in production.
   

  

 Private AI systems require decisions around model selection, inference, evaluation, latency, infrastructure, data pipelines, retrieval, cost, and reliability.
   

  

 Our AI Engineering team works on this layer.
   

  

 We are looking for interns who want to understand how modern AI systems work beyond prompt engineering and hosted APIs, and who are interested in learning how models are deployed, evaluated, and integrated into real products.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an
 **AI Engineering Intern** 
 , you will work primarily on the AI layer of our products and solutions.
   

  

 You will help deploy and evaluate open\-weight models, build inference and retrieval pipelines, experiment with model configurations, and expose AI capabilities for application teams to use.
   

  

 You will work primarily with
 **Python** 
 and gain hands\-on experience with technologies around model serving, LLM inference, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, evaluation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and open\-weight models.
   

  

 You are not expected to already be an expert in model deployment or fine\-tuning. We are looking for strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.
   

  

 What You'll Work On
   

  

 Depending on the project, you may work on:
   

  

* Deploying open\-weight language and embedding models.
* Building and testing model inference APIs and services.
* Comparing models based on quality, latency, throughput, memory usage, and cost.
* Building RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems.
* Creating evaluation datasets and running model and application\-level evaluations.
* Experimenting with prompts, model parameters, retrieval strategies, and inference configurations.
* Working with GPUs, containers, cloud infrastructure, and model\-serving frameworks.
* Investigating model failures and understanding why different models behave differently.
* Documenting experiments so results can be reproduced and compared.
* Working with Software Engineers to expose AI capabilities to production applications.


 Qualifications
   

  

 We care more about strong fundamentals and your ability to learn than whether you already know every AI framework.
   

  

 You should have:
   

  

* Strong Python fundamentals.
* Good programming and problem\-solving ability.
* Basic understanding of APIs, data structures, Git, and software development.
* Interest in understanding how machine learning and large language models work beyond using hosted APIs.
* Ability to read technical documentation and implement unfamiliar concepts.
* Comfort experimenting, measuring results, and investigating unexpected behaviour.
* At least one meaningful technical project through coursework, a personal project, internship, research, hackathon, or similar work.
* Ability to clearly explain what you built, what worked, what failed, and what you learned.


 Prior experience with model deployment, RAG, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vector databases, GPUs, or cloud infrastructure is useful, but not required.
   

  

 We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them. We are not interested in testing whether you can memorize APIs or write every line of code without assistance.
   

  

 What matters is whether you can
 **understand what the system is doing, verify results, question incorrect assumptions, debug failures, and explain your reasoning.**
 Using AI effectively is useful. Blindly accepting its output is not.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 This is
 **not a prompt\-engineering internship** 
 .
   

  

 You may work with prompts, but the role goes deeper into models, inference, retrieval, evaluation, and AI infrastructure.
   

  

 This is also not primarily a data analytics or traditional data science role.
   

  

 You will work closer to the engineering of AI systems — getting models to run reliably, evaluating their behaviour, understanding trade\-offs, and making those capabilities usable by application teams.
   

  

 You are also not expected to already be an AI specialist. The role is designed for someone with strong fundamentals who wants to build that specialization.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**Why Join Abstrabit**
 You will get the opportunity to work close to the core AI systems behind production applications.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Work with private and open\-weight AI models rather than only hosted model APIs.
* Learn how models are deployed, evaluated, benchmarked, and operated in production environments.
* Gain exposure to inference, RAG, model serving, evaluation, GPUs, and AI infrastructure.
* Work closely with Software Engineers who build applications on top of the systems you help create.
* Receive technical guidance and feedback from experienced engineers.
* Gradually take ownership of larger experiments, systems, and technical decisions as you grow.
* Build practical AI engineering skills that sit between machine learning and production software engineering.


**Our Interview Process**
 Our hiring process is designed to understand how you approach unfamiliar technical problems rather than how many AI tools are listed on your resume.
   

  

**Step 1: Application Screening \-** 
 We review your technical fundamentals, projects, and evidence that you have spent time building, experimenting, or learning deeply.
   

  

**Step 2: Practical AI Engineering Assessment \& Discussion \-** 
 You will work through a practical technical problem and discuss your approach with one of our engineers.
   

  

 The problem may involve Python, APIs, model outputs, retrieval, debugging, or interpreting experimental results. We may ask you to explain your approach, investigate an issue, modify your solution, or reason about why one result differs from another.
   

  

 We are interested in how you learn, experiment, validate results, and respond when something does not work as expected.
   

  

**Step 3: Final Conversation \-** 
 A discussion about the role, your learning goals, expectations, and whether Abstrabit is the right environment for you.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Data Analyst** 




**Experience: 1–2 Years** 




  





**About Setu** 




 Setu is reimagining financial products for the next billion users.
 



 Millions of Indians still cannot access insurance, credit, investments, and other financial products through the formal channels many of us take for granted. Setu is solving this by reducing the cost of financial\-product distribution.
 



 We break products such as
 **loans, insurance, investments, payments, and account aggregation** 
 into fundamental building blocks and offer them as APIs to businesses. This enables companies to build highly customised fintech experiences for their customers and launch products in days instead of months.
 



 Setu is an acquired entity of
 **Pine Labs** 
 , one of the fastest\-growing fintech companies in India, with a rapidly expanding presence across Asia, the UAE, and the US.
 



 At Pine Labs, we believe in
 **“Every Day is Game Day”** 
 — bringing our best selves to work every day to build products that enrich the world through digital commerce and financial services.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Setu's Data team works across
 **lending, collections, payments, and account aggregation** 
 . We turn transaction data into decisions — for our products as well as for the banks, lenders, and businesses that consume Setu APIs.
 



 As a
 **Data Analyst** 
 , you will own the numbers that product, business, and leadership teams rely on every day — and the analysis behind the decisions they make.
 



 You will work with
 **real production data at scale** 
 , across multiple products, with direct exposure to how our products, partners, and customers work.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys going beyond reporting — someone who wants to understand
 **why a number changed, what it means for the business, and what should happen next.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 




 Product Analytics \& Business Thinking
 


* Start with the
 **business question** 
 and understand the product, customer journey, and business model before analysing the data.
* Translate ambiguous business goals into measurable metrics such as
 **adoption, conversion, success rate, turnaround time, and drop\-offs** 
 .
* Define metrics clearly, align on definitions and edge cases, and ensure consistency across teams.
* Turn analysis into actionable recommendations with a clear
 **“so what?”**
* Analyse user and API journeys end\-to\-end to identify drop\-offs, opportunities, and changes in behaviour.



 Dashboards \& Reporting
 


* Build and own dashboards used by product, business, and leadership teams.
* Analyse
 **funnels, cohorts, segments, partners, merchants, and time\-based trends** 
 .
* Build reusable datasets and documented metric definitions to enable self\-serve analytics.
* Support
 **A/B tests and pre/post analyses** 
 , including guardrail metrics.
* Own recurring business reviews — from the numbers and commentary to follow\-ups.



 SQL, Python \& Data Quality
 


* Write SQL every day using
 **joins, aggregations, CTEs, subqueries, and window functions** 
 against large transactional datasets.
* Investigate slow queries and understand issues related to scan volume, joins, partitions, and data modelling.
* Build intermediate tables and views that make downstream analysis faster and more consistent.
* Use
 **Python, pandas, and Jupyter** 
 for data cleaning, transformation, and analysis.
* Validate data before publishing: check
 **row counts, nulls, duplicates, date boundaries, unit mismatches, and source\-system reconciliation** 
 .
* Investigate data\-quality issues to identify root causes and work with engineering teams to fix them.
* Automate recurring data\-quality checks and alerts.
* Familiarity with
 **dbt, Jinja\-templated SQL, testing, and documentation** 
 is a plus.



 MLOps Support
 


* Support the data science team with operational data requirements.
* Prepare training and evaluation datasets.
* Connect outcome labels to historical model predictions.
* Contribute to basic monitoring of live model performance and drift.



 AI\-Native Analytics
 


* Use
 **AI tools and coding assistants** 
 to write SQL, explore unfamiliar schemas, analyse data, document work, and automate repetitive tasks.
* Understand where AI\-generated outputs can be unreliable and
 **verify queries, analysis, and conclusions before using them** 
 .
* Build lightweight tools, scripts, prompts, or automations that make recurring analytical workflows more efficient.



 Ownership \& Communication
 


* Proactively identify problems worth solving rather than waiting for tasks to be assigned.
* Take ownership of analytical problems from
 **question → analysis → insight → action** 
 .
* Communicate findings clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Treat the numbers and dashboards you publish as your product.
* Maintain clear documentation of code, metric definitions, assumptions, and methodology.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **1–2 years of experience** 
 as a Data Analyst or in a similar data\-focused role.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* **Strong SQL is a hard requirement.** 
 You should be comfortable with:
* Joins
* Group By and aggregations
* Subqueries
* CTEs
* Window functions
* Working with unfamiliar schemas
* Working knowledge of
 **Python, pandas, and Jupyter** 
 .
* Strong
 **Excel or Google Sheets** 
 skills, including pivot tables and advanced analysis.
* Experience building dashboards using any BI tool such as
 **Metabase, Superset, Looker, Power BI, Tableau** 
 , or similar.
* Regular use of
 **AI tools** 
 in your analytical or coding workflow.
* Strong product thinking — you understand what decision a metric is intended to support.
* High attention to
 **data accuracy and correctness** 
 .
* Working knowledge of basic statistics, including
 **distributions, percentiles, sampling, and statistical significance** 
 .
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and owning problems end\-to\-end.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.



 Good to Have
 


* Familiarity with
 **Git** 
 .
* Exposure to how
 **ML models are evaluated and monitored in production** 
 .
* Curiosity or experience in
 **fintech** 
 , particularly lending, payments, collections, or account aggregation.
* Familiarity with
 **dbt** 
 .



  





**How We Interview** 




 Our interview process focuses on three areas:
 



**1\. Technical Skills** 



* SQL
* Python
* Real\-world data problems



**2\. Problem Solving \& Product Sense** 



* Scoping ambiguous questions
* Choosing the right metrics
* Analysing funnels and cohorts
* Reasoning through trade\-offs
* Converting analysis into actionable insights



**3\. How You Work** 



* Ownership
* Communication
* Use of AI tools
* Data quality mindset
* Ability to work independently



  





**Why Setu?** 




 At Setu, we want you to work on problems that have real\-world impact.
 



 You'll get the opportunity to:
 


* Work closely with the founding team that has built and scaled public infrastructure such as
 **UPI, GST, and Aadhaar** 
 .
* Work with real production data across fintech products at scale.
* Solve challenging problems across lending, payments, collections, and account aggregation.
* Learn through a fully stocked library and
 **unlimited book budget** 
 .
* Attend conferences and industry events.
* Participate in learning sessions with internal and external experts.
* Use our learning and development allowance for courses, certifications, subscriptions, and more.



 Benefits
 


* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Personal accident and term life insurance.
* Access to mental health counsellors.
* Learning and development allowance.
* A beautiful office with natural light and solid\-wood interiors.
* Great coffee.



  





**Our Culture** 




 Our culture code,
 **How We Move** 
 , defines the behaviours we expect from everyone at Setu.
 



**Take the shot** 
 — Decide fast and deliver right.
 



**Sign your work like an artist** 
 — Master what you do and take pride in it.
 



**Be the sherpa** 
 — Lead your crew on every expedition.
 



**Be the CEO of what you do** 
 — Own it and make things happen.
 



**Care with tough love** 
 — Empower others through trust, respect, and openness.
 



**Own tomorrow** 
 — Innovate for the customer and beyond.
 



 If you want to work on challenging data problems, build products that power financial services, and use data to drive real business decisions,
 **we'd love to hear from you.**
