title: IOS QA Manual Tester
description:
****About The Role****
 We are looking for a
 **QA Tester** 
 to own day\-to\-day quality of our
 **iOS** 
 application. You will write and execute test cases, manage test work in
 **Azure DevOps** 
 , and use
 **SQL Server** 
 to set up data, check results, and prove defects. You will partner with product, iOS development, and QA to catch issues before release and keep test evidence in ADO.
   

  

 This role is execution\-led: you turn stories and acceptance criteria into runnable tests, run them on real devices, and back pass/fail with SQL Server evidence.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
**iOS testing**
* Write and execute functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, and negative tests for the iOS app.
* Test on physical iPhones and the iOS Simulator; cover agreed iOS versions, device sizes, and orientations.
* Validate iOS behavior: login, permissions (camera, photos, location, notifications), backgrounding, app kill/relaunch, rotation, Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, locale/timezone, and TestFlight vs debug builds.
* Test offline/online sync, poor network, and data that must round\-trip from the device to the backend and back.
* Reproduce and isolate iOS defects with clear steps, screenshots, screen recordings, device/OS/build, and Console / crash evidence where available.
* Perform risk\-based regression on high\-impact journeys before each release.
* Partner with developers on build availability, environment issues, and device\-specific failures.
* Contribute to go/no\-go input for iOS releases.


**Azure DevOps**
* Author and maintain test cases, test suites, and test plans in Azure DevOps Test Plans.
* Link tests and bugs to PBIs, user stories, and bugs on Azure Boards; keep work items accurate through the sprint.
* Execute test runs, record pass / fail / blocked, and attach evidence in ADO.
* Log defects with severity/priority, repro steps, expected vs actual, iOS device/OS/build, and linked work items.
* Track testing progress against sprint/release scope; flag blocked tests and environment issues early.


**SQL Server**
* Write SQL Queries against SQL Server (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, aggregations) to verify what the iOS app saved.
* Use SQL Server to set up and reset test data (accounts, jobs, sites, statuses, dates) in QA following data\-safety rules.
* Confirm create/update/delete and sync: device action vs rows in SQL Server.
* Investigate data mismatches (wrong counts, stale rows, timezone/datetime, missing FKs) and attach query results to bugs.
* Validate lists, reports, and widgets against SQL Server source data, not UI\-only checks.
* Use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) or Azure Data Studio for day\-to\-day query work.


**Quality process**
* Translate acceptance criteria into test cases, including edge cases and negative paths.
* Keep a living iOS regression suite; retire obsolete cases and add coverage when features change.
* Communicate status, risks, and defect trends in standups and release reviews.
* Document tests so another tester can run the same suite without tribal knowledge.


****Required Qualifications****
* 3\+ years software QA experience, including 2\+ years hands\-on iOS testing (native or hybrid).

description:
**Job Description:** 




 A DevOps engineer is a professional who is responsible for the continuous delivery and deployment of software in an agile team. The DevOps engineer works closely with the development and operations teams to automate and streamline the build, test, and deployment processes, and to ensure that the software can be quickly and reliably delivered to users.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About ThoughtSpot** 




 ThoughtSpot is the leader in Agentic Analytics, helping organizations turn natural language into governed, trusted insight through Spotter and our broader analytics platform. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, with hubs across North America, EMEA, and India, we're a fast\-growing B2B SaaS company built on continuous innovation and a genuine passion for making AI work for the people who use it every day.
 



  





**Member of Technical Staff** 




**About the Role** 




 At ThoughtSpot, we're building the future of analytics with AI at the core. As a
 **Member of Technical Staff** 
 , you'll join a team of world\-class engineers working on technologies that power our next\-generation analytics platform. From distributed systems and high\-performance backend services to AI\-powered search and natural language understanding, you'll work on challenging engineering problems at scale while learning from experienced mentors. This is an opportunity to build products that are used by some of the world's leading enterprises and make an impact from day one.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems that process large volumes of data with high performance and reliability.
* Build production\-grade software using languages such as
 **Java, Go, Python, or C\+\+** 
 .
* Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of core platform components.
* Improve the scalability, performance, and reliability of distributed systems.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code following engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, debugging, and problem\-solving with experienced engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, agile environment.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.
* Strong foundation in
 **Data Structures, Algorithms, Object\-Oriented Programming, and Software Engineering** 
 .
* Good understanding of core Computer Science fundamentals, including
 **Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Databases, and Distributed Systems** 
 .
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as
 **Java, C\+\+, Go, or Python** 
 .
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills with a passion for building scalable software.
* Curiosity to learn, ownership, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative engineering environment.
* Internship, academic projects, or hands\-on experience in backend systems, distributed systems, cloud technologies, or AI/ML is a plus.



  





**Why Join ThoughtSpot?** 



* Work on cutting\-edge AI and distributed systems challenges at enterprise scale.
* Learn from experienced engineers through mentorship, code reviews, and collaborative design.
* Build products that power data\-driven decisions for global organizations.
* Grow in a culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Make meaningful contributions from the very beginning of your career.



  





**In\-Office at ThoughtSpot** 




 Spotters are expected in\-office 3\+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem\-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in\-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
 



  





**About ThoughtSpot** 




 The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI\-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C\-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large\-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision\-making into a truly data\-driven culture.
 



 At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data\-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
 



**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles** 




 Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
 


* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands\-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry\-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.



 Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
 


* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary



 This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
 



  





**AI Mindset for All Spotters** 




 At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
 



 All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
 



  





**ThoughtSpot for All** 




 At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
 



  





**What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?** 




 ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives \- this balance\-for\-the\-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world\-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.

description:

 This role offers the opportunity to help organizations strengthen their cybersecurity and compliance programs across a range of recognized frameworks and regulatory standards. You will manage client engagements from implementation through ongoing compliance activities, working directly with stakeholders to deliver measurable program outcomes. The position combines hands\-on GRC execution, client relationship management, technical risk remediation, and project coordination. You will support a portfolio of accounts while collaborating with analysts and cross\-functional technical teams to keep compliance initiatives moving efficiently. The role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys a fast\-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly and client experience is a central focus. * Coordinate evidence collection, compliance milestones, project deliverables, and task execution across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Conduct control testing, readiness reviews, and structured compliance assessments to identify gaps and maintain alignment with applicable requirements.
* Identify, assess, and track cybersecurity risks and control deficiencies in collaboration with technical and business stakeholders.
* Partner with IT, security, operations, and other cross\-functional teams to develop and execute remediation plans.
* Communicate directly with client stakeholders through email, chat, and video meetings to gather evidence, clarify requirements, resolve issues, and provide progress updates.

* Coordinate effectively with analysts and other delivery team members to ensure engagement milestones and quality standards are met.
* Contribute to improving delivery processes, templates, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Support the scaling of GRC service delivery by identifying opportunities for greater consistency, efficiency, and automation.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities, customer requirements, and specialized compliance engagements.

* Hands\-on experience delivering cybersecurity compliance or GRC initiatives within technology\-focused environments.
* Practical experience working with at least one major framework such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.

title: Service Engineer
description:
CORPCULTUREJob Description – Service Engineer (Field \& Service)

**Job Title:** Service Engineer – Field \& Service  
**Department:** Service \& Technical Operations  
**Location:** Chennai / Customer Locations  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

CorpCulture is looking for a **Service Engineer** responsible for installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and servicing of printers and related office equipment at customer locations. The engineer will also coordinate with the service team and maintain proper service records.

Key Responsibilities

* Visit customer locations for printer installation, service, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware and technical issues in printers and multifunction devices.
* Perform preventive maintenance and breakdown service.
* Attend service calls within the assigned SLA and provide timely resolution.
* Install and configure printers, scanners, and related devices.
* Identify defective parts and coordinate for replacement or repair.
* Handle printer cleaning, servicing, consumable replacement, and maintenance.
* Support printer rental installations, replacements, shifting, and de\-installation.
* Record service activities, engineer visit details, machine status, and parts used in the company application/system.
* Collect customer acknowledgement/signature after completion of service.
* Update service reports and close service tickets accurately.
* Coordinate with the office/service coordinator regarding pending and unresolved issues.
* Escalate major technical issues to the senior engineer or management.
* Maintain assigned tools, spare parts, and company assets responsibly.
* Follow customer\-site safety and security requirements.
* Maintain professional communication and good customer relationships.
* Travel to different customer locations as required.

Technical Skills

* Basic knowledge of laser printers and multifunction printers.
* Knowledge of printer hardware components and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of printer installation and configuration.
* Basic knowledge of networking and printer connectivity.
* Knowledge of replacing printer spare parts and consumables.
* Ability to identify and resolve common printer errors.
* Basic computer hardware and software troubleshooting knowledge.

Required Skills

* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting ability.
* Good communication with customers.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations.
* Ability to work independently in the field.
* Time management and punctuality.
* Proper documentation and service reporting.
* Responsible handling of company tools and spare parts.

Qualification \& Experience

* ITI / Diploma / Any Technical Qualification preferred.
* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may apply.
* Experience in printer service, copier service, computer hardware, or networking will be an advantage.

Key Performance Areas

* Timely attendance of service calls.
* Resolution of technical issues within SLA.
* Quality of service and customer satisfaction.
* Accurate service report and system updates.
* Proper handling of spare parts and company assets.
* Reduction of repeat service complaints.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Threat Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Engineer to join our Threat Intelligence team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain infrastructure, tools, and capabilities that enables the Threat Intelligence team to perform threat intelligence analysis and dissemination. You will create tools, automations, dashboards, data pipelines, and integrations that enable fast, scalable, and centralized access to threat intelligence data. The ideal candidate will have strong engineering skills and past experience in security operations.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager of the Threat Intelligence team.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Architect, construct, and maintain robust infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing cyber threat intelligence data
* Implement engineering best practices to maximize data quality and operational visibility for threat analysis
* Develop and deploy scalable automation workflows to streamline threat intelligence operations
* Collaborate with analysts to translate operational requirements into high\-performing, reliable technical solutions
* Produce technical documentation, interactive dashboards, and key metrics to measure system performance and business impact


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* 3\+ years of proven experience in cyber threat intelligence engineering, incident response, security automation, or data engineering
* Hands\-on experience leveraging Generative AI for security operations, including prompt definition, model benchmarking, and integrating scalable AI solutions into intelligence workflows
* Demonstrated ability to configure, deploy, and maintain threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) and integrate structured threat data into enterprise security tools
* Proficiency in creating and managing interactive Python notebooks (e.g., Jupyter, Marimo), configuring data connections, building reusable workflows, and documenting analytical processes
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred**
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-based data platforms, automation services, and infrastructure\-as\-code in AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Proficiency with Git\-based development practices, including branching, pull requests, code review, CI/CD, and automated testing
* Experience integrating threat intelligence platforms with enterprise security tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and case\-management systems
* Knowledge of threat intelligence standards and data technologies, including STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT\&CK, Python, SQL, APIs, and relational, graph, or search databases
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
   

  

 If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
   

  

 Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Territory Service Representative NHC 378414
description:
About DHL Blue Dart Express India:  

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.  

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.  

  

  

Position Overview:
The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.
Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.  

Job Purpose:
To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Pickup \& Delivery Operations* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

  

Customer Service Excellence* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

  

COD \& Documentation Management* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

  

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

  

Safety \& Security* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

  

Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 8th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:  

Technical Skills:* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

  

Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Delivery \& Pickup Performance On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity
Service Quality First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction
COD \& Documentation COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors
Safety \& Compliance Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance
Operational Productivity Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

title: Network Management AIOps Specialist
description:
We are looking for a motivated resource to support end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise network services across on\-premises and cloud environments. This role focuses on maintaining stable, secure, and compliant network operations while learning service governance, incident management, observability, and automation practices (including AI\-assisted operations under supervision).


**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Service Management and Delivery**

* Support daily operations of enterprise network services and assist in improving service quality.
* Help monitor incidents, coordinate with teams for restoration, and document root cause and preventive actions.
* Track SLAs/KPIs and contribute to service performance reports.
* Assist in managing LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD\-WAN, VPN, firewall, DDI (DNS/DHCP/IPAM), and remote access services.
* Use AI\-assisted operations tools (triage/recommendations) with defined approval and audit controls.

**2\. Governance and Service Controls**

* Assist in operational review meetings, change control (CAB), and risk review processes.
* Maintain service documentation such as runbooks, SOPs, service catalog, and RACI.
* Support vendor performance tracking and service improvement actions.
* Follow AI governance controls, including approval workflows and fallback procedures.

**3\. Network and Cloud Operations**

* Support monitoring of network connectivity, segmentation, resilience, and performance across sites and cloud.
* Assist with secure cloud connectivity patterns and integration with enterprise applications.
* Participate in operational readiness for migrations and new services.
* Help ensure AI\-enabled operations are monitored and controlled for reliable delivery.

**4\. AIOps, Observability, and Customer Experience**

* Support observability activities: telemetry monitoring, event correlation, and alert handling.
* Help identify recurring issues for automation and auto\-remediation opportunities.
* Track customer\-impact metrics and contribute to service improvement initiatives.
* Assist in AIOps lifecycle tasks with guidance from senior team members.

**5\. Stakeholder Communication**

* Support regular updates to internal stakeholders (business teams, architecture, cyber security, audit, and leadership).
* Help translate technical incidents into business impact updates.
* Assist in preparing reports for service performance and major incidents.
* Communicate AI usage boundaries and human oversight points when required.

**6\. Continuous Improvement, Audit, and Compliance**

* Contribute to process improvements using ITIL/SRE/DevOps practices.
* Track key metrics such as availability, MTTR, incident recurrence, and change success rate.
* Maintain audit\-ready evidence, documentation, and remediation records.
Support security and risk teams in vulnerability, patch, and access compliance activities.  
* 

**Education \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Internship/project experience in networking, cloud, or IT operations is a plus.
ITIL Foundation (or willingness to complete within first year) preferred.  
* 

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of experience (internship/training/academic projects acceptable).
Exposure to enterprise networking or cloud operations is an advantage.  
* 

**Key Skills**

* Basic understanding of ITIL service management (incident, problem, change).
* Foundational knowledge of networking: LAN/WAN/WLAN, VPN, firewall, DNS/DHCP/IPAM.
* Basic understanding of cloud networking concepts (preferably AWS).
* Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools and automation basics is a plus.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Willingness to learn AI\-assisted operations, governance controls, and compliance practices.  
* 

**Preferred Certifications (Optional)**

* ITIL Foundation
* CCNA (or equivalent networking foundation)
* AWS Cloud Practitioner / networking\-related cloud certification

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer\-oriented **Field Service Engineer** to support our ISP network operations. * Ability to identify and troubleshoot fiber cuts, optical power loss, and connectivity issues.

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. title: HR Executive
description:
HR EXECUTIVE — RECRUITMENT \& CANDIDATE COORDINATION

Experience: Fresher – 1 year

Salary: ₹20,000 – ₹40,000 per month (based on skill and experience)

Location: 515, Gera Imperium Rise, Opposite Wipro, Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune

Type: Full\-time, on\-site

ABOUT US

We're hiring across almost every function at once right now — developers, designers, operations, security, content, social media — sometimes ten roles open at the same time. Right now, one person is running all of that screening alone.

THE ROLE

This role supports our HR function on the day\-to\-day recruitment grind — sending out screening questionnaires, following up with candidates, organising responses, and keeping every open role's pipeline moving instead of sitting in someone's inbox. If a good candidate goes cold because nobody followed up, that's this role's gap to close.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

\- Send our standard screening questionnaire to applicants — experience, current company, current and expected CTC, notice period, skills and years, projects, problem\-solving examples, resume and portfolio, best time to call

\- Follow up with candidates who haven't replied, politely and persistently, until you get a real answer

\- Organise every candidate's response and resume so the team can review them in minutes, not hours

\- Schedule interview calls and coordinate calendars between candidates and the hiring team

\- Keep a running, accurate tracker of every open role — how many applied, how many screened, how many scheduled, how many rejected and why

\- Draft and send candidate communication — screening messages, interview invites, rejections — professionally and on time

\- Post job openings across the platforms we use, and keep listings current as roles open and close

\- Support onboarding paperwork and documentation for candidates who get selected

\- Flag any pattern worth knowing — a role getting no real applicants, a question candidates keep struggling with

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

\- Fresher to 1 year — internships in HR or recruitment count

\- Clean, professional written English — you'll be messaging candidates directly, and it has to read right

\- Genuinely organised — juggling several open roles and dozens of candidates without losing track of any of them

\- Comfortable on the phone — calling and following up with candidates who haven't replied

\- Basic comfort with spreadsheets or a simple tracker tool

\- Reliable and consistent — candidates dropping through the cracks because of a missed follow\-up is not acceptable

\- A genuine interest in recruitment, not HR as a fallback choice

BONUS POINTS

\- HR\-related internship or coursework (BBA/MBA HR, certification, or similar)

\- Experience with any applicant tracking or recruitment tool

\- Comfortable screening technical or creative profiles, even without deep technical knowledge yourself

\- Bilingual — Hindi and English both

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

\- Not a strategic HR or policy role — that sits above this one

\- Not a one\-role\-at\-a\-time job — several pipelines run in parallel, every day

\- Not a role where candidates wait a week for a reply — follow\-ups happen the same day

HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1\. Resume

2\. Expected salary and notice period (or availability, if you're a fresher)

3\. A 3\-4 line note on why recruitment/HR specifically interests you

Applications without the note will not be reviewed.

Mail to: hr@dhanode.com

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pune, Maharashtra

description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:
   

  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

description:

 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results on a scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 4 locations – 2 in India, 1 in Poland, and 1 in Mexico, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). We work across industries, including Technology, Consumer Products, Retail and Healthcare. * Write clean, reusable, testable, and efficient code to develop scalable, flexible, user\-friendly applications across a robust technology stack including the use of AI and LLMs

* Support the supervisor in work\-planning and brainstorming projects

* Leverage opportunities to provide training, coaching and mentoring to fellow team members
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and internal training within the PEG and broader BCN community




**About you** 






 Must\-have skills:
 



* Strong programming skills in Python and its Frameworks (Fast API/Flask), Proven experience in enterprise service layer delivery.
* Core data processing \& analytics skills via Python (Pandas, NumPy, Xlsxwriter)
* Hands\-on experience working with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI’s Responses API) including prompt design, response handling and Vector Embedding in respective DB.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating external services along with some ORM (Object Relational Mapper) libraries.
* Familiarity with modern development tools like Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
* Good understanding of relational and non\-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
* Writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
* Understanding of front\-end and back\-end architecture and design principles
* Sound SDLC skills, preferably with experience in an agile environment
* Quick learner, willing to get into the details; good at thriving in a fast\-paced environment and able to work independently
* Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively interface across cross\-functional teams



  






 Good\-to\-have skills:
 



* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies such as Angular, React and HTMX
* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and associated components such as EC2, Lambda and S3 for AWS
* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and NLP
* Basic understanding of Web Services protocols such as SOAP and GRAPHQL design for extensibility and portability







  




 Educational qualification \& Professional experience 
 



* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science engineering or related field
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills
* Work experience range in case highest qualification is undergraduate studies\- 2\-5 years of experience in backend\-software development preferably with 1 year of exposure to business research and consulting preferred
* Work experience range in case highest qualification is postgraduate studies\- 0\-3 years of experience in backend\-software development preferably with 1 year of exposure to business research and consulting preferred

 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. description:

**Job Purpose:** 




 To own the in\-engine look development of immersive surgical training modules by assembling 3D assets, configuring materials, lighting, environments, post\-processing, cameras, and training UI within Unity. The role will ensure that art assets are correctly integrated, visually consistent, performance\-optimized, and delivered as development\-ready Unity scenes for implementation by Unity developers and simulation engineers.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Unity Look Development \& Scene Creation** 




 • Build, configure, and maintain Unity scenes for immersive surgical training modules.

 • Configure scene hierarchy, prefabs, transforms, cameras, lighting, materials, and environmental settings.

 • Design and implement realistic lighting setups for operating\-room and surgical training environments.

**3\. Materials \& Rendering Setup**

 • Develop textures from 3D model and sculpt handoffs while preserving required surface details and visual fidelity.
 



 • Ensure physically accurate material response appropriate for real\-time surgical simulation.
 



**2\. Channel\-Packed Texture \& Technical Art Workflows** 




 • Create and maintain channel\-packed textures to optimize GPU memory and material performance.
 



 • Implement project\-specific packing standards such as:
 


* R \= Metallic
* G \= Ambient Occlusion
* A \= Smoothness
* • Ensure gloss/smoothness and roughness maps are correctly converted and exported according to the defined Unity pipeline.
* • Validate packed textures for accuracy, consistency, and compatibility with Unity materials.
* • Support optimization of texture memory through efficient channel usage and resolution management.



**3\. Trim Sheet \& Modular Asset Texturing** 




 • Develop and maintain trim\-sheet workflows for modular surgical instruments, robotic components, and environment asset families.
 



 • Create efficient UV layouts that maximize texture\-space utilization.
 



 • Ensure consistent material appearance across assets using shared trim sheets and reusable texture libraries.
 



 • Support modular asset development while minimizing redundant texture memory and draw\-call overhead.
 



**4\. UV Mapping \& Texel Density Management** 




 • Create and optimize UV layouts using Maya, Blender, or equivalent tools.
 



 • Maintain consistent texel density across the complete asset library.
 



 • Ensure appropriate UV packing and utilization based on asset importance and camera visibility.
 



 • Support second UV channel creation for lightmap UVs where baked lighting is used.
 



 • Identify and resolve UV overlaps, stretching, distortion, seams, and inefficient texture\-space utilization.

 .

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




 Cosmoserve Space is dedicated to building a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through advanced active debris removal technologies. The company’s mission is to safeguard the orbital environment with high\-tech, cost\-effective solutions that address the growing challenge of space debris. Cosmoserve Space combines cutting\-edge engineering with a market\-leading approach to responsible space operations. Team members collaborate in a passionate, expert\-driven environment that values innovation, reliability, and long\-term impact. The organization is focused on ensuring that space remains accessible and safe for current and future missions.
 



  





**Role Description** 





 Cosmoserve Space is looking for a
 
 Computer Vision Engineer who is working on perception systems for spacecraft and space\-object relative navigation. He/She will design and build algorithms that estimate the 6\-DoF (position and orientation) of non\-cooperative or known space objects for autonomous rendezvous, proximity operations, and docking. This role sits at the intersection of classical computer vision (detection, geometry, calibration) and modern deep learning, with heavy use of synthetic data generated in simulation environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Building vision\-based relative navigation pipelines for object detection, instance/semantic segmentation, and pose estimation of rigid space objects.
 



 · Working with PnP algrithms and RANSAC, epipolar geometry, and homography\-based pose recovery techniques, along with feature descriptors such as SIFT, ORB, etc
 



 · Applying data augmentation and domain randomization strategies to close the sim\-to\-real gap across illumination, albedo, distance, and attitude variations.
 



 · Handling classical image processing tasks, including filtering, morphological operations, and edge/contour and blob detection, alongside learned features.
 



 · Generating and curating photorealistic synthetic datasets in Blender, using procedural scenes, domain randomization, and automated ground\-truth pose/segmentation export.
 



 · Working across stereo and monocular camera geometry, including depth estimation, triangulation, and multi\-view sensor fusion.
 



 · Managing camera calibration workflows, including intrinsic/extrinsic parameters, lens distortion modeling, and stereo rectification, for single and multi\-camera rigs.
 



 · Optimizing and deploying models on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, using TensorRT, ONNX, and CUDA for real\-time inference, including profiling and quantization.
 



 · Collaborating with GNC (Guidance, Navigation \& Control) and simulation teams to feed pose and uncertainty estimates into the navigation filter.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 · 2\+ years of relevant industry or research experience with a master’s degree, or 4\+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 · Strong foundation in computer vision and deep learning: CNN backbones, detection architectures, segmentation architectures, pose estimation networks.
 



 · Solid grasp of projective geometry: PnP with RANSAC and Experience in applying data augmentation and domain randomization for robust, generalizable models.
 



 · Strong command of classical image processing using OpenCV (filtering, morphology, feature extraction, edge/contour detection).
 



 · Working knowledge of stereo and monocular camera geometry, depth estimation, and rectification.
 



 · Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, and NumPy, with hands\-on experience in model training, evaluation, and profiling.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 · Hands\-on
 **camera calibration** 
 experience (single or multi\-camera, intrinsic/extrinsic).
 



 · Prior exposure to spacecraft navigation, robotics perception, or similar safety\-critical vision applications.
 



 · Familiarity with sensor fusion and state estimation (e.g., Kalman filtering) in a navigation context.

title: SDE II, Last Mile
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. Node Receive COD team handles the process of receiving packages, routing them back to right origin, and handling Cash on delivery reconciliations and liabilities among driver, station and bank.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an SDE\-2, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of software components. Senior Engineers provide technical leadership at Amazon. They help establish technical standards and drive Amazon’s overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and methodologies. They work on our hard problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs. They think globally when building systems, ensuring Amazon builds high performing, scalable systems that work well together. Senior engineers are pragmatic visionaries who can translate business needs into workable technology solutions. Their expertise is deep and broad. They are hands on, producing both detailed technical work and high\-level architectural designs.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Internship
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Hardware Engineering**
------------------------------


Hardware Engineering owns the aircraft's physical development, from a concept sketch to a part that flies. This spans system design, mechanism design, and structural design: working out how something moves, what it's made of, and whether it holds up under real load. Because most of what we design is custom, it also means designing the equipment we use to prove our work — rigs, jigs, and testers built specifically to validate a design before it goes anywhere near a real flight. It's one team across concept, design, initial prototyping, and test: the full arc of getting a product from an idea to something that ships.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring a Mechanical Engineering Intern \- for freshers and university students who've built things with their own hands, not just studied how to. No prior professional experience is required; what we're looking for instead is real, hands\-on project experience: BAJA, FSAE, robotics teams, personal builds, or similar.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Mechanism \& Assembly Design**

* Support the design and development of mechanisms and mechanical assemblies for our aircraft, from early concept through production intent
* Build and test prototypes yourself — this is a hands\-on role, not a design\-and\-hand\-off one

**Analysis \& Validation**

* Assist with load calculations, tolerance stacks, basic FEA, and weight budgets to validate designs before they're cut or molded

**Manufacturing Process Exposure**

* Work with composites layup, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and CNC machining to learn how to choose the right process for each part

**Composites \& Structures Track**

* If focused on composites/structures: help us model and design composite structures — laminate design, layup optimization, and structural analysis — rather than just building to a fixed layup

**Mechanism Design Track**

* If focused on mechanism design help select actuation hardware — servos, stepper motors, and similar — and write short scripts to drive and test them

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**
--------------

* Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in mechanical engineering or a related field
* Real hands\-on project experience (BAJA, FSAE, robotics, or similar build teams) that demonstrates genuine mechanism design or composites/structures work, not just coursework
* Working familiarity with 2D and 3D CAD
* Basic understanding of load calculations, tolerance analysis, and weight budgeting
* Strength in at least one of the following:


	+ Detailed mechanism design (including actuation hardware selection and basic scripting to drive and test it)
	+ Composites and structures (modeling and analysis, not just layup execution)
* Strong attention to detail and a willingness to get hands\-on with hardware
* Clear communicator, comfortable working with both internal teams and external vendors
* Willingness to go the extra mile when a project needs it

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* In\-office role, working alternate Saturdays.

**Ready to take off?**

title: Senior Travel Consultant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION  
Company: Book My Tour Now

**Website:** www.bookmytournow.com  
**Job Title:** Travel Consultant  
**Department:** Sales \& Travel Consulting  
**Location:** Sector 48,Gurugram, Haryana  
**Reports To:** Sales Manager / Team Leader

About Book My Tour Now

**Book My Tour Now** is a customer\-focused Tours \& Travels company providing customized travel packages and travel\-related services for domestic and international customers.

We focus on understanding each customer's travel requirements, creating suitable travel solutions, managing bookings efficiently, and providing support throughout the travel planning process.

Our goal is to deliver a smooth and reliable customer experience through **personalized travel solutions, timely communication, organized booking processes, and strong coordination between Sales and Operations teams.**

Job Summary

The **Travel Consultant** will be responsible for handling customer travel inquiries, understanding their requirements, preparing customized travel packages and quotations, following up with prospective customers, and converting inquiries into confirmed bookings.

The role involves managing the customer journey from the **initial inquiry through quotation, follow\-up, booking, payment, confirmation, and handover to the Operations Team.**

The Travel Consultant will also be responsible for maintaining accurate customer and follow\-up information in the CRM, coordinating internally for booking execution, and ensuring timely and professional communication with customers.

This position plays an important role in **lead conversion, sales growth, customer satisfaction, and smooth booking coordination.**

Key Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Lead Management \& Customer Contact

* Manage assigned leads and initiate customer contact according to the daily sales plan.
* Respond to customer inquiries through phone, WhatsApp, email, and other approved communication channels.
* Understand the customer's travel plans, preferences, budget, and expectations.
* Maintain regular and disciplined follow\-ups until the inquiry is closed.

2\. Understanding Customer Requirements

Collect and understand important travel requirements, including:

* Destination
* Departure city
* Travel dates
* Number of passengers
* Number and type of rooms
* Hotel category
* Trip duration
* Inclusions and exclusions
* Sightseeing requirements
* Transportation requirements
* Flight requirements
* Food preferences
* Special requests
* Approximate travel budget

3\. Travel Package Preparation

* Prepare customized travel packages based on customer requirements.
* Select suitable existing packages or create customized packages when required.
* Review itinerary details, hotels, transportation, sightseeing, flights, and other travel services.
* Ensure that package details are accurate and aligned with customer requirements.

4\. Quotation Preparation \& Presentation

* Prepare accurate quotations based on available costing and approved pricing.
* Review day\-wise itineraries, hotel details, flight information, inclusions, exclusions, and pricing before sharing quotations.
* Share quotations with customers through email, WhatsApp, or other approved channels.
* Explain package details, pricing, inclusions, exclusions, terms, and conditions clearly to customers.
* Make approved changes to quotations based on customer feedback.

5\. Customer Follow\-Up \& Sales Conversion

* Follow up with customers at mutually agreed times.
* Understand customer feedback and address questions or concerns.
* Revise packages and quotations where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate follow\-up dates and customer responses in the CRM.
* Work consistently toward converting qualified inquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.

6\. Booking \& Payment Coordination

* Confirm booking requirements with customers before proceeding.
* Collect required customer information and documents.
* Generate and share payment links through approved payment platforms.
* Guide customers through the payment process when required.
* Record full or partial payments accurately.
* Ensure customer and transaction information is updated correctly in the CRM and relevant systems.

7\. Sales \& Operations Coordination

* Coordinate with the Operations Team for:
* Flight availability and booking
* Hotel availability and confirmation
* Sightseeing
* Transfers
* Transportation
* Costing
* Guest details
* Special requests
* Final booking confirmations
* Ensure all relevant customer information is properly handed over to the Operations Team.
* Follow up internally to ensure timely execution of confirmed bookings.

8\. Booking Documentation \& Customer Communication

* Share booking confirmations, tickets, invoices, payment details, vouchers, and other required documents with customers.
* Ensure customer\-facing documents are accurate before sharing.
* Maintain complete and updated customer records.
* Ensure all relevant communication and booking information is properly documented in the CRM.

9\. CRM \& Record Management

* Maintain accurate lead, customer, quotation, follow\-up, booking, and payment information in the CRM.
* Update lead status and follow\-up activities on a timely basis.
* Record customer requirements, discussions, quotation changes, and important commitments.
* Ensure no important customer information or follow\-up activity is missed.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
* Experience in **Tours \& Travels, Travel Sales, Travel Consulting, Customer Service, Hospitality, or a related field** will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of domestic and international travel processes is preferred.
* Candidates with experience handling customer inquiries, sales calls, quotations, and follow\-ups will be preferred.

Skills \& Abilities

The candidate should possess:

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer\-handling and relationship\-building skills.
* Good sales and follow\-up discipline.
* Ability to understand customer travel requirements.
* Ability to prepare and explain travel packages and quotations.
* Good negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple customer inquiries simultaneously.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Basic computer and documentation skills.
* Attention to detail while entering customer, booking, and payment information.
* Professional attitude and customer\-focused approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with Sales and Operations teams.
* Willingness to learn new destinations, travel products, packages, and company processes.
* Ability to work toward sales targets and business objectives.

Tools \& Technology

The Travel Consultant will regularly work with:

* CRM / Lead Management System
* Razorpay or similar payment platform
* Zoho Email
* WhatsApp
* MS Excel
* MS Word

title: Relationship Manager - Leading NBFC - Gurugram
description:
**Job Description – Senior Relationship Manager – MSME Lending / Investments**
==============================================================================


**Location:** Delhi / Gurugram


**Type:** Full\-time


**Experience:** 3–8 years


**Industry Preference:** NBFC / MSME Lending / SME Lending / Financial Services


**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are looking for a Senior Relationship Manager with strong experience in NBFC/MSME lending or investment sales, along with the ability to understand and analyze financial statements.


The candidate will be responsible for sourcing and developing relationships with MSME/SME businesses, identifying lending and investment opportunities, understanding business requirements, conducting preliminary financial analysis, and managing the relationship through the transaction lifecycle.


### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. Business Development \& Sales**


* Source new MSME/SME lending and investment opportunities through direct sourcing, referrals, CA networks, DSAs, financial advisors, and industry contacts.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with SME/MSME promoters, business owners, and CXOs.
* Identify businesses that meet the lending/investment requirements of the assigned business or entity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients and opportunities.
* Achieve assigned business development, sourcing, and revenue targets.

#### **2\. Relationship Management**


* Manage relationships with existing and prospective MSME/SME clients.
* Understand the client's business model, financial requirements, funding needs, and growth plans.
* Act as the primary point of contact and ensure smooth coordination throughout the transaction process.
* Develop long\-term relationships with promoters, referral partners, and other stakeholders.

#### **3\. Financial Analysis \& Initial Assessment**


* Analyze P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements of prospective businesses.
* Understand profitability, leverage, liquidity, working capital, and cash\-flow position.
* Conduct preliminary assessment of the company's financial strength and repayment/investment capacity.
* Review financial information and identify key business and financial risks.
* Coordinate with the Credit/Risk/Investment teams for detailed evaluation and underwriting.

#### **4\. Deal Execution \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with internal teams including Credit, Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations, and Compliance.
* Support the transaction process from sourcing and initial evaluation through sanction/investment and disbursement, wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely collection of financial and business documents from clients.
* Support structuring of suitable lending/investment solutions based on business requirements.

#### **5\. Portfolio \& Relationship Monitoring**


* Maintain regular engagement with clients and monitor business performance.
* Track repayment/business performance and identify potential concerns or early warning signals.
* Support repeat business and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records and MIS of business sourced and relationships managed.

### **Ideal Candidate**


* 3–8 years of relevant experience in NBFC, MSME/SME lending, business banking, or financial services.
* Strong experience in MSME lending or investment sales.
* Existing network among MSME/SME promoters, CAs, DSAs, financial advisors, and business networks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand and analyze financial statements and business performance.
* Good understanding of credit, lending, and financial products.
* Strong relationship management, communication, negotiation, and sales skills.
* Ability to balance business development with financial/business assessment.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA or equivalent qualification will be an advantage.
### **Not Suitable**


* Pure retail loan sales profiles.
* Candidates with only retail lending experience.
* Pure sales profiles without understanding of financial statements.
* Freshers or candidates without relevant NBFC/SME/MSME experience.
### **What We Offer**


* Opportunity to work with a growing financial services group.
* Exposure to MSME lending, investments, and multiple businesses within the Company.
* Direct interaction with business owners and senior management.
* Growth\-oriented role with business development and financial analysis exposure.
* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
### **Important Note**


The selected candidate may be aligned with any specific business, vertical, subsidiary, associate, or entity within the Company based on organizational requirements.


The candidate may also be employed on the payroll of Company. or any other entity within the Company, as determined by management and business requirements.
