title: Nykaa - Product Manager II
description:
**Role : Product Manager II \| Nykaa Fashion**
**Location :** 
 Gurgaon \|
 **Experience :** 
 2 \- 4 years \|
 **Team :** 
 Product \- Nykaa Fashion
   

  

 Fashion meets Product. And we're looking for someone who gets both.
   

  

 Nykaa Fashion is building the next generation of fashion shopping experiences \- experiences that are more visual, inspiring, social and AI\-native.
   

  

 We're looking for a Product Manager II to work on some of our newest bets : ideas that may start with a customer insight, prototype or experiment and have the potential to become entirely new experiences for millions of shoppers.
   

  

 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap and optimize it by 2%.
   

  

 You'll find problems worth solving, build from zero, experiment quickly and scale what works.
   

  

 And there's one thing we care about beyond the usual PM toolkit : You should genuinely love fashion.
   

  

 You notice what people are wearing. You know when a trend is taking off. You have opinions on how people discover brands, put together looks and decide what to buy.
   

  

 You don't just work on fashion. You talk about it. You follow it. You wear it.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 You'll work on 0 \- 1 bets for Nykaa Fashion across areas such as :
   

  

* New Discovery Experiences : Rethink how shoppers discover fashion beyond traditional homepages, PLPs and search \- from visual and inspiration\-led discovery to new content\-led shopping formats.
* AI x Fashion : Explore how Generative AI can change fashion shopping \- styling, personalization, conversational shopping, visual discovery and completely new interfaces.
* Content x Commerce : Build experiences where reels, creators, UGC, trends and editorial content become native parts of the shopping journey.


**What You'll Do**
* Build 0 \- 1 : Take ambiguous ideas from customer problems \- hypothesis \- prototype \- MVP \- experiment \- scale.
* Think customer\-first : Spend time understanding how people actually discover, evaluate and buy fashion \- not just what funnel dashboards tell us.
* Experiment aggressively : Run rapid experiments, learn what works and be equally comfortable scaling a winner or killing an idea.
* Use AI as a product primitive : Prototype with LLMs, multimodal models and emerging AI capabilities rather than treating AI as an add\-on.
* Own outcomes : Define clear customer and business metrics and take accountability for impact, not feature launches.
* Work deeply with Design \& Engineering : Build alongside designers and engineers from day one rather than throwing requirements over the fence.
* Stay culturally curious : Track fashion, creators, Gen Z behaviour, global commerce products and emerging consumer experiences \- and translate those signals into product ideas.


**Who We're Looking For**
 2 \- 4 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet or e\-commerce.
   

  

**You Will Probably Thrive Here If**
* You've shipped meaningful consumer products and can demonstrate measurable impact.
* You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited precedent.
* You have strong product intuition but are equally comfortable getting into data.
* You understand experimentation, funnels and consumer behaviour.
* You can work effectively with Design, Engineering, Analytics and Business teams.
* You're naturally curious about AI and how it changes consumer products.
* You move fast, prototype before over\-specifying, and learn from real users.
* Prior e\-commerce, discovery, personalization, content, social commerce or AI product experience is a strong plus.


 And the biggest plus? You are a fashion enthusiast. Not because your resume says Fashion / E\-commerce. Because you genuinely have a point of view on fashion. You follow brands, creators and trends. You understand why someone saves a look on Instagram, searches for it on Google, asks a friend about it and eventually buys something completely different.
   

  

 We want someone who can bring that instinct into the products they build.
   

  

**Why Nykaa Fashion? :**
 Because fashion e\-commerce still has a lot left to reinvent.
   

  

 Most shopping experiences today are built around catalogues, filters and funnels. The next generation will increasingly be built around inspiration, identity, creators, personalization and AI.
   

  

 At Nykaa Fashion, you'll get the scale of a major consumer platform with the opportunity to operate like a small 0 \- 1 product team. Millions of shoppers. Thousands of brands. And plenty of unsolved problems.
   

  

 Come build what fashion shopping looks like next!

	+ Excavation and earthwork
	+ PCC/RCC works
	+ Reinforcement and shuttering
	+ Foundation and structural works
	+ Masonry and plastering
	+ Road, drainage and flooring works
	+ Equipment foundations and related civil works
* Monitor day\-to\-day site activities and ensure execution as per approved drawings and instructions.
* Assist in checking **line, level, alignment, dimensions, and quantity** of executed work.

* Coordination with site departments and subcontractors.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Front End Developer
description:
**Job Title: Frontend Developer** 

**Job Type: Full\-time**

**Experience Level: Junior/Mid\-Level**

**Job Summary:**  
We are seeking a skilled and creative Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in UI design to join our team. In this dual\-role position, you will combine technical frontend development skills with a keen eye for design to create responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling web interfaces.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Frontend Development:**
* Develop responsive and high\-performance web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.
* Integrate APIs and third\-party libraries to enhance functionality.
* **UI Design:**
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs for web and mobile applications.
* Design user\-friendly interfaces that align with branding guidelines and user needs.
* Conduct usability testing and incorporate feedback to refine designs.
* **Collaboration:**
* Work closely with product managers, UX designers, and backend developers to deliver cohesive user experiences.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to enhance user interfaces and interactions.
* **Quality Assurance:**
* Perform thorough testing to ensure a bug\-free and visually consistent experience.
* Debug and resolve frontend issues efficiently.
* **Continuous Learning:**
* Stay updated on the latest trends and best practices in frontend development and UI/UX design.
* Propose innovative solutions to improve user experience and interface aesthetics.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend frameworks.
* Experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma, Sketch, or similar.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Knowledge of SEO principles and accessibility standards.
* **Design Skills:**
* Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout principles.
* Ability to translate wireframes into functional, user\-friendly designs.
* **Soft Skills:**
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Attention to detail and a passion for delivering high\-quality work.
* Problem\-solving mindset and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
